title: Senior Software Engineer
description: <div class="content-intro"><h4><strong>Join Axon and be a Force for Good.</strong></h4> <p>At Axon, we’re on a mission to Protect Life. We’re explorers, pursuing society’s most critical safety and justice issues with our ecosystem of devices and cloud software. Like our products, we work better together. We connect with candor and care, seeking out diverse perspectives from our customers, communities and each other.<br><br>Life at Axon is fast-paced, challenging and meaningful. Here, you’ll take ownership and drive real change. Constantly grow as you work hard for a mission that matters at a company where you matter.</p></div><h3>Your Impact</h3> <p>This role is for builders who thrive in 0→1. In Axon’s Global Artificial Intelligence pillar, you’ll build a stealth product with a small team and a big mission: deliver something the market hasn’t seen, and do it with pace.<br><br>As a Senior Software Engineer I, you’ll lead key areas of the product from concept through launch. You’ll make pragmatic architecture decisions, keep quality high while moving fast, and help the team turn prototypes into a scalable product.<span class="Apple-converted-space"> </span><br><br>This is an AI-native delivery role: AI is a primary lever for how you ship, not an add-on and you have true Product acumen and ability to craft and build products end to end. <em><br></em></p> <h3>What You’ll Do</h3> <ul> <li>Lead the build of major product surfaces and services; own features end-to-end from design to operations.</li> <li>Drive product clarity in ambiguity: define the problem, shape MVP scope, set success metrics, and align stakeholders on what “done” means.</li> <li>Build and ship software AI-natively across the SDLC (planning, implementation, testing, code review, debugging, and operations), with clear validation practices to maintain correctness and quality.</li> <li>Measure and improve delivery outcomes using engineering metrics (lead time, PR throughput, defect rates, test coverage, incident load) and iterate on how the team ships.</li> <li>Make architecture choices that balance speed and scalability—knowing when “temporary” becomes “permanent.”</li> <li>Build and enforce engineering hygiene that doesn’t slow you down (testing strategy, CI/CD, observability, sensible release practices).</li> <li>Partner tightly with Product and Design (and operate effectively when they’re not in the room) to prioritise, sequence, and ship the highest-value increments.</li> <li>Mentor engineers and help establish a high-trust, high-ownership culture.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Work Location: </strong>This role is based out of our London office and follows a hybrid schedule. We rely on in-person collaboration and ask that team members work onsite Tuesdays through Fridays, with the flexibility to work remotely on Mondays, unless there is an approved workplace accommodation. We believe that connection fuels innovation, and our in-office culture is designed to foster meaningful teamwork, mentorship, and shared success.<br><strong>Reports to: </strong>SVP, AI</p> <h3>What You Bring</h3> <h4>Required Skills</h4> <ul> <li>Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience.</li> <li>7+ years of software development experience, including ownership of product capabilities in production.</li> <li>Demonstrated, heavy AI-native delivery: consistent use of AI across the SDLC with concrete examples of faster delivery and maintained/improved quality.</li> <li>Strong engineering judgement under uncertainty; ability to simplify and still build something great.</li> <li>Experience building cloud-native services and/or modern user experiences that scale.</li> <li>Comfort working across boundaries: product, design, customers, and platform dependencies.</li> <li>Product judgement sufficient to ship: ability to frame problems, define MVP scope, make trade-offs, and drive to measurable customer outcomes.</li> </ul> <h4>Preferred Qualifications</h4> <ul> <li>Startup or internal incubation experience.</li> <li>Experience integrating AI/LLM capabilities into product experiences responsibly.</li> <li>Track record of accelerating teams through strong technical leadership.</li> <li>Experience operating in PM-light environments where engineers help drive prioritisation and discovery alongside delivery.</li> </ul> <h3>Benefits that benefit you</h3> <ul> <li>Competitive base salary and RSUs</li> <li>Comprehensive pension plan with matching contribution</li> <li>Private health insurance & cash plans</li> <li>30 days paid holiday + UK public holidays</li> <li>Enhanced maternity/paternity leave</li> <li>GymPass subscription</li> <li>Life assurance & income protection</li> <li>Career growth support and wellness resources</li> </ul> <p><em>Benefits listed herein may vary depending on the nature of your employment and the location where you work.</em></p> <p><em> </em></p> <p> </p><div class="content-conclusion"><p>Don’t meet every single requirement? That's ok. At Axon, we Aim Far. We think big with a long-term view because we want to reinvent the world to be a safer, better place. We are also committed to building diverse teams that reflect the communities we serve.</p> <p>Studies have shown that women and people of color are less likely to apply to jobs unless they check every box in the job description. If you’re excited about this role and our mission to Protect Life but your experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification listed here, we encourage you to apply anyways. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.</p> <p><strong>Important Notes</strong></p> <p><em>The above job description is not intended as, nor should it be construed as, exhaustive of all duties, responsibilities, skills, efforts, or working conditions associated with this job. The job description may change or be supplemented at any time in accordance with business needs and conditions.</em></p> <p><em>Some roles may also require legal eligibility to work in a firearms environment.</em></p> <p><em>We collect personal information from applicants to evaluate candidates for employment. You may request access, deletion, or exercise other CCPA rights at <strong data-stringify-type="bold"><a class="c-link c-link--underline" ----- target="_blank" ----- ----- via our <a class="c-link c-link--underline" href="https://privacyportal.onetrust.com/webform/0efc1702-9321-4119-bc9d-a06c3a1d3e4e/ca57cc26-a159-4193-9f6e-58ffe3fd2509" target="_blank" data-stringify-link="https://privacyportal.onetrust.com/webform/0efc1702-9321-4119-bc9d-a06c3a1d3e4e/ca57cc26-a159-4193-9f6e-58ffe3fd2509" data-sk="tooltip_parent">Axon Privacy Web Form</a>. For more information, please see the Your California Privacy Rights section of our <a class="c-link c-link--underline" href="https://www.axon.com/candidateprivacypolicy" target="_blank" data-stringify-link="https://www.axon.com/candidateprivacypolicy" data-sk="tooltip_parent">Applicant and Candidate Privacy Notice.</a></em></p> <p><em>Axon’s mission is to Protect Life and is committed to the well-being and safety of its employees as well as Axon’s impact on the environment. title: Account Executive - Greenfield - London UK
description: <div class="content-intro"><div> <div> <div class="gmail_quote"> <div> <div><span id="m_-113912706363268805m_-2746164444908759431gmail-docs-internal-guid-131e4fb0-7fff-b4e9-ff50-e8cf32449b1b">CoreWeave is The Essential Cloud for AI™. Built for pioneers by pioneers, CoreWeave delivers a platform of technology, tools, and teams that enables innovators to build and scale AI with confidence. Trusted by leading AI labs, startups, and global enterprises, CoreWeave combines superior infrastructure performance with deep technical expertise to accelerate breakthroughs and turn compute into capability. Founded in 2017, CoreWeave became a publicly traded company (Nasdaq: CRWV) in March 2025. Learn more at <a href="https://www.coreweave.com">www.coreweave.com</a>.</span></div> <div> </div> <div>We're proud to be a Living Wage accredited Employer.</div> </div> </div> </div> </div> <p> </p></div><p><strong>What You’ll Do:</strong><br>An Enterprise Account Executive at CoreWeave is a quota carrying, enterprise software sales position responsible for meeting and exceeding goals through generating and closing new opportunities while increasing awareness of CoreWeave in the marketplace.</p> <p><strong>About the role:</strong></p> <p>Role and Responsibilities</p> <ul> <li>Drive new business into the UK Enterprise & AI Native territory</li> <li>Develop and implement a sales strategy aligned to regional and industry needs to help drive awareness, engagement and growth</li> <li>Focused pipeline generation on defined top target accounts/sub-sectors</li> <li>Collaborating with technology ecosystem and alliance partners to accelerate new opportunity discovery</li> <li>Manage opportunities through the sales cycle from initial inquiry/outbound interaction through to forecasted pipeline</li> <li>Meet quarterly and annual revenue objectives for territory, whilst reporting on sales, activities, progress on a regular basis through CRM and sales forecasting tools</li> </ul> <p><strong>Who You Are:</strong></p> <p>We are looking for motivated, focused, and coachable sales professionals with experience across the full spectrum of the software sales cycle – prospecting, defining and articulating value proposition, pilot process management, business case development, negotiation and closing.</p> <p><strong>Requirements:</strong></p> <ul> <li>5+ years of progressive SaaS or infrastructure sales experience</li> <li>Consistent track record of success in closing business</li> <li>Excellent negotiation, analytical, financial, and organizational capabilities. Able to thrive in an evolving, entrepreneurial structure and environment</li> <li>Outstanding verbal and written communication skills</li> <li>Ability to work at both a tactical and strategic level</li> <li>Must possess a can-do, self-starter mentality in a highly collaborative atmosphere</li> <li>Competence leveraging value selling frameworks such as Command of the Message and forecasting methodologies such as MEDDPICC</li> </ul> <p><strong>Preferred:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience selling to AI/ML leaders and builders</li> </ul> <p><strong>Wondering if you’re a good fit? </strong><strong>We believe in investing in our people, and value candidates who can bring their own diversified experiences to our teams – even if you aren't a 100% skill or experience match.</strong><strong> Here are a few qualities we’ve found compatible with our team. If some of this describes you, we’d love to talk. </strong></p> <ul> <li>You love to help individuals and organizations be successful utilizing new technologies, acting as a trusted advisor.</li> <li>You’re curious about the AI industry as a whole, the use cases organisations are deploying into production, and the technical challenges and opportunities associated.</li> <li>You’re an expert in end-to-end sales process management.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Why CoreWeave?</strong></p> <p>At CoreWeave, we work hard, have fun, and move fast!  We’re in an exciting stage of hyper-growth that you will not want to miss out on. We’re not afraid of a little chaos, and we’re constantly learning. Our team cares deeply about how we build our product and how we work together, which is represented through our core values: </p> <ul> <li>Be Curious at Your Core</li> <li>Act Like an Owner</li> <li>Empower Employees</li> <li>Deliver Best-in-Class Client Experiences</li> <li>Achieve More Together</li> </ul> <p>We support and encourage an entrepreneurial outlook and independent thinking. We foster an environment that encourages collaboration and provides the opportunity to develop innovative solutions to complex problems. As we get set for take off, the growth opportunities within the organization are constantly expanding. You will be surrounded by some of the best talent in the industry, who will want to learn from you, too. Come join us! </p> <p>The starting salary will be determined by job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and the market location. We strive for both market alignment and internal equity when determining compensation. In addition to base salary, our total rewards package includes a discretionary bonus, equity awards, and a comprehensive benefits program (all based on eligibility).</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><em>To fulfill our obligation to protect client data, successful applicants offered employment with CoreWeave will be required to complete a basic criminal record check, conducted in compliance with GDPR. Employment offers are conditional upon receiving satisfactory check results.</em></p> <p><strong>What We Offer</strong></p> <p>In addition to a competitive salary, we offer a variety of benefits to support your needs, including:</p> <ul> <li>Family-level Medical Insurance</li> <li>Family-level Dental Insurance </li> <li>Generous Pension Contribution </li> <li>Life Assurance at 4x Salary </li> <li>Critical Illness Cover </li> <li>Employee Assistance Programme </li> <li>Tuition Reimbursement</li> <li>Work culture focused on innovative disruption</li> </ul> <p><em>Benefits may vary by location. </em></p> <p><strong>Equal Opportunity </strong></p> <p><em>CoreWeave is an equal opportunity employer, committed to fostering an inclusive and supportive workplace. All qualified applicants and candidates will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, disability, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran status, or genetic information.</em></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;"><strong>Recruitment Agencies</strong></span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;"><em><em data-stringify-type="italic">CoreWeave does not accept speculative CVs. Any unsolicited CVs received will be treated as the property of CoreWeave and your Terms & Conditions associated with the use of CVs will be considered null and void.</em></em></span></p> <p><em><span style="font-weight: 400;"><em data-stringify-type="italic">Any unsolicited CVs sent by your company to us – that is to say, in any situation where we have not directly engaged your company in writing to supply candidates for a specific vacancy – will be considered by us to be a “free gift”, leaving us liable for no fees whatsoever should we choose to contact the candidate directly and engage the candidate’s services, and will in no way establish any prior claim by your company to representation of that candidate should the candidate’s details also be submitted by any other party.</em></span></em></p> <p><strong>Export Control Compliance</strong></p> <p>This position requires access to export controlled information.  To conform to U.S. Government export regulations applicable to that information, applicant must either be (A) a U.S. person, defined as a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful permanent resident (green card holder), (iii) refugee under 8 U.S.C. § 1157, or (iv) asylee under 8 U.S.C. § 1158, (B) eligible to access the export controlled information without a required export authorization, or (C) eligible and reasonably likely to obtain the required export authorization from the applicable U.S. government agency.  CoreWeave may, for legitimate business reasons, decline to pursue any export licensing process.</p> <p> </p> <p><strong><em>Updated privacy notice - UK and EU Job Applications </em></strong></p> <p><em>When you apply to a job on this site, the personal data contained in your application will be collected by CoreWeave UK Ltd. (“Controller”), which is located at</em></p> <p><em>Phosphor (6th Floor), 133 Park Street, London, SE1 9EA</em></p> <p><em>and can be contacted by emailing ----- Controller’s data protection officer can be contacted at ----- Your personal data will be processed for the purposes of managing Controller’s recruitment related activities, which include setting up and conducting interviews and tests for applicants, evaluating and assessing the results thereto, and as is otherwise needed in the recruitment and hiring processes. Such processing is legally permissible under Art. 6(1)(f) of (i) Regulation (EU) 2016/679 (General Data Protection Regulation (“GDPR”) and (ii) the GDPR as it forms part of the laws of the UK (“UK GDPR”), as necessary for the purposes of the legitimate interests pursued by the Controller, which are the solicitation, evaluation, and selection of applicants for employment. Your personal data will be shared with Greenhouse Software, Inc., a cloud services provider located in the United States of America and engaged by Controller to help manage its recruitment and hiring process on Controller’s behalf. With respect to transfers originating from the UK or the European Economic Area ("EEA") to a country outside the UK or the EEA, we implement the appropriate transfer mechanism(s) and other appropriate solutions to address cross-border transfers as required by applicable law. You may request a copy of the suitable mechanisms we have in place by contacting us at </em><a ---------- <p><em>Your personal data will be retained by Controller as long as Controller determines it is necessary to evaluate your application for employment. Where permitted by applicable law, we may also retain your personal data for a limited period after the recruitment process ends in order to consider you for future job opportunities, respond to legal claims, or comply with record-keeping obligations. Under the GDPR and the UK GDPR, you have the right to request access to your personal data, to request that your personal data be rectified or erased, and to request that processing of your personal data be restricted. You also have the right to data portability. I

title: Mid-Level Software Engineer
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>At Ledgy, we’re on a mission to make Europe a powerhouse of entrepreneurship by building a modern, tech-driven equity management and financial reporting platform for private and public companies. In 2026, we aim to be the leading provider for European IPOs and reporting for share-based payments. We are a value-based company with a core focus on being humble, transparent, ambitious and impactful, all in order to delivery the best experience for our customers and end users.</p> <p>We are proud to partner with some of the world’s leading investors. New Enterprise Associates led our <a href="https://techcrunch.com/2022/09/21/ledgy-a-carta-for-european-startups-to-manage-equity-and-cap-tables-raises-22m-from-nea-sequoia-and-more/">$22m Series B</a> round in 2022, with Philip Chopin joining Sequoia’s Luciana Lixandru on our board.</p> <p>We were founded in Switzerland in 2017 and today we operate globally from offices in Zurich and London. We encourage diversity and are an international team coming from 26 different countries and speaking 25 different languages.</p> <p> </p></div><p><strong>About the role</strong></p> <p>As a <strong>Mid-level Software Engineer</strong> at Ledgy, you’ll build reliable, scalable product experiences that help companies manage their equity with confidence. You’ll work closely with experienced engineers, product managers, and designers to turn complex equity workflows into clear, automated, user-friendly software.</p> <p>This role is a strong fit if you’re ready to take ownership of well-scoped projects, grow your technical judgement, and contribute across the stack while learning from senior peers.</p> <p>Location: We hire remotely across the UK, Spain, Germany, Poland, and Romania. For candidates based in London, we use a hybrid model with 2 days in the office per week.</p> <p><strong>Teams we are hiring for:</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Core Equity</strong> — Owns the foundational logic that powers Ledgy’s equity engine. Every equity-related event — such as issuing shares, creating new pools, or adjusting ownership — generates transactions. This team defines and maintains the transaction logic, data model, and core domain behaviour that ensure Ledgy’s platform remains accurate, scalable, and compliant. They also enable employees to sell their shares seamlessly once vested.</li> <li><strong>Workflows & Automation</strong> — Focuses on automating complex equity workflows and integrating with third-party services, including the trading exchange. The team builds systems that help company admins efficiently onboard and offboard employees, automate equity grants and terminations.</li> <li><strong>Reporting</strong> — Transforms Ledgy’s core equity data into financial, operational, and compliance reports. The team manages large, complex datasets and ensures reporting is accurate, performant, and reliable across jurisdictions and company structures. Their work powers the insights companies and auditors rely on for decision-making and transparency.</li> <li><strong>Tax</strong> — Ensures taxes are correctly reflected throughout equity operations, especially moments such as exercising, selling, mobility, and other taxable events. As a future team, Tax will build end-to-end product capabilities across the stack, helping customers manage complex tax and compliance requirements accurately across jurisdictions.</li> </ul> <p><strong>You will thrive in the role if you</strong></p> <ul> <li>You have 3+ years of experience working as a Software Engineer</li> <li>You are comfortable building and shipping production-quality features across the stack</li> <li>You enjoy learning complex domains and turning them into simple, maintainable product experiences</li> <li>You care about clean, tested, readable code and thoughtful collaboration</li> <li>You are curious about equity, financial workflows, and their real-world impact on companies and employees</li> <li>You’re excited to grow your technical judgement through code reviews, pairing, and architecture discussions</li> <li>You take ownership of your work while asking for input early when trade-offs are unclear</li> </ul> <p><strong>Our Tech Stack*:</strong></p> <p>We have a modern, cohesive stack that lets us move fast while maintaining quality:</p> <ul> <li><strong>Language:</strong> TypeScript</li> <li><strong>Frontend:</strong> React, Tailwind CSS, tRPC</li> <li><strong>Backend:</strong> tRPC, Node.js, MongoDB, Temporal</li> <li><strong>Infrastructure:</strong> GCP, Terraform Cloud, Kubernetes, Docker, GitHub Actions</li> </ul> <p>*We don’t expect proficiency in this specific stack</p> <p><strong>What Your Journey Could Look Like</strong></p> <p><strong>First 30 days:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Be paired with an onboarding buddy who will introduce you to the world of equity management</li> <li>Get to know your engineering team, product managers, and designers</li> <li>Learn how your team’s domain connects to the broader Ledgy platform</li> <li>Set up your development environment and start contributing small, well-scoped changes</li> <li>Build familiarity with our codebase, product workflows, and engineering practices</li> </ul> <p><strong>First 3 months:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Ship product features and improvements with increasing independence</li> <li>Work with teammates to break down problems, understand trade-offs, and deliver reliable solutions</li> <li>Participate actively in code reviews and team discussions</li> <li>Develop a deeper understanding of how companies manage and automate equity</li> <li>Contribute to improving quality, maintainability, and user experience in your team’s domain</li> </ul> <p><strong>First 6–12 months:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Own medium-sized features from implementation through release</li> <li>Collaborate with Product and Design to shape pragmatic, user-centric solutions</li> <li>Contribute to technical discussions around data models, workflows, and scalability</li> <li>Continue growing toward senior-level ownership, judgement, and impact</li> </ul> <p><strong>The interview process:</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Getting to know you (45 min):</strong> Meet with someone from our people team to talk about your experience and to ask questions about the role <ul> <li>Hackerrank take-home assessment (30-45mins) - this is a test to assess core coding cability</li> </ul> </li> <li><strong>Live Coding (60 min):</strong> An equity domain problem to solve collaboratively using your preferred language and IDE. We want to see how <strong>you</strong> think, so this step does not allow AI. But you can freely look up syntax questions if you need to.</li> <li><strong>System Design (60 min):</strong> A system design session focused on practical problem-solving, clear trade-offs, and how you structure technical thinking</li> <li><strong>Behavioural (45 min):</strong> Answer behavioural style questions about your experience, using the STAR method - with a PM and EM.</li> <li><strong>Culture Interview:</strong> A chance to meet one of our founders and your hiring manager for a 30-minute chat about Ledgy’s mission and values</li> <li><strong>Offer</strong> 🎉</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>Being part of Ledgy means:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Recharge and re-energize with flexible working hours, 25 days of vacation, and up to 40 days of remote work from outside your home country.</li> <li>We make space for your own professional development, with a generous yearly learning & development budget.</li> <li>This role will receive a competitive salary + benefits + equity. All salaries are aligned with competitively benchmarked ranges based on work location and levelling.</li> <li>For candidates based in London or Zurich we use a hybrid work model of 2 days in the office per week.</li> </ul> <p> </p> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: AI Systems - Senior Software Engineer
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>At Ledgy, we’re on a mission to make Europe a powerhouse of entrepreneurship by building a modern, tech-driven equity management and financial reporting platform for private and public companies. In 2026, we aim to be the leading provider for European IPOs and reporting for share-based payments. We are a value-based company with a core focus on being humble, transparent, ambitious and impactful, all in order to delivery the best experience for our customers and end users.</p> <p>We are proud to partner with some of the world’s leading investors. New Enterprise Associates led our <a href="https://techcrunch.com/2022/09/21/ledgy-a-carta-for-european-startups-to-manage-equity-and-cap-tables-raises-22m-from-nea-sequoia-and-more/">$22m Series B</a> round in 2022, with Philip Chopin joining Sequoia’s Luciana Lixandru on our board.</p> <p>We were founded in Switzerland in 2017 and today we operate globally from offices in Zurich and London. We encourage diversity and are an international team coming from 26 different countries and speaking 25 different languages.</p> <p> </p></div><p><strong>About the Role</strong></p> <p>As a Software Engineer on our AI Systems team, you'll build the AI foundations and product experiences of Ledgy: the Ledgy Agent, the tools and skills it runs on, our MCP server, and the platform capabilities that let other teams embed AI safely in their domains. You'll collaborate with fellow engineers, product managers, and designers in a new and fast-moving product area where correctness matters as much as speed - our customers need equity data they can trust.</p> <p><strong>Location:</strong> We hire remotely across the UK, Spain, Germany, Poland, and Romania. For candidates based in London, we use a hybrid model with 2 days in the office per week.</p> <p><strong>The team you'll join:</strong><br>AI Systems - Develops Ledgy's AI foundations and product experiences, from AI agents and AI-assisted workflows to the platform capabilities that help other teams embed AI safely in their domains. The team works in a new and evolving product area, balancing rapid iteration with reliable execution, evaluation tooling, and responsible automation.</p> <p><strong>What You'll Work On</strong></p> <p>Help build the future of how companies manage equity.</p> <ul> <li><strong>Ledgy Agent.</strong> You'll design and build the system behind our in-app agent, so equity administrators can do through AI what they do manually in the app today. Ledgy Agent takes real actions and runs real analysis on live equity data, like onboarding a stakeholder end to end, and administrators depend on its accuracy and observability. You'll design the tools, skills, context, and orchestration behind it, and how it decides to handle each request.</li> <li><strong>Ledgy MCP.</strong> Not everyone wants to open Ledgy to get things done. Our MCP server lets customers bring equity into the AI agents and tools they already use. You'll shape it alongside the in-app agent, so a capability built once works in both places, and you'll decide what we expose and how we keep it safe.</li> <li><strong>Measuring and improving the agent.</strong> You'll design and build the system we use to measure the agent's quality and learn from how customers use it: evaluations, tracing, and feedback from real conversations. You decide what "good" means for customers, how we measure it, and how what we learn changes what we build next.</li> <li><strong>Scaling.</strong> The Ledgy web application, the agent, MCP, and surfaces we haven't built yet all need the same capabilities. You'll design the foundations that let us build AI features once and reuse them everywhere, and that let other teams add AI to their domains without compromising correctness. You'll also design how it runs as usage grows: the backend infrastructure, cost, and latency behind the agent and MCP, and how we keep them reliable and observable.</li> </ul> <p>You'll own real parts of this and have a say in where we invest. You'll also spend time with customers to see how administrators actually use the agent, and use that to decide what to build next.</p> <p><strong>You'll Thrive in This Role If You</strong></p> <p>Don't worry if you don't tick every box. These are the things that would make you an especially good fit.</p> <ul> <li>You have 5+ years of experience working as a Software Engineer, with strong TypeScript/Node fundamentals across back end and front end</li> <li>You've built and shipped agentic or LLM-based software to production, such as an agent, an assistant, or a chat product, and you've been the one running it. You've debugged failures in real conversations and kept cost and latency in check as usage and models changed.</li> <li>You've designed the agent itself: tools and skills, context and prompt engineering, state, streaming, and the agent loop. You know at least one agent framework or runtime well and can say where it works and where it doesn't.</li> <li>You improve these systems with evidence. Evals, regression sets, tracing, and feedback from real usage tell you whether a change helped, and you use them to decide what to do next.</li> <li>You keep up with what the foundation labs and the wider community are learning about building agents. You try new techniques early and judge which ones make our product better and are worth adopting now, and which should wait.</li> <li>You take part in deciding what we build. title: Senior Platform Engineer
description: V7 At V7, we’re building AI platforms that help humans do their best work, at incredible scale and speed. Our mission is to turn human knowledge into trustworthy AI, making complex tasks faster, smarter, and more accurate. We’re growing fast, backed by leading investors and AI pioneers (including the minds behind Transformers and Gemini). The product V7 Go helps teams turn complex, repeatable work into AI workflows they can run, review and improve . Built for private markets, insurance and real estate, it supports investment diligence, underwriting, claims review and portfolio reporting—from analysing documents and data to generating deliverables and updating connected systems. Your experts define how the work should be done. V7 combines reusable Skills, shared company knowledge and configurable workflows, with citations, audit logs and human review to help teams verify results and control key decisions. It supports models including GPT, Claude and Gemini. Build workflows around your processes. Configure each stage, choose models and tools, and set review steps where human judgement matters. Teams can inspect sources, correct outputs and refine workflows over time. Explore workflows . Give every workflow your firm’s knowledge. The Context Graph connects documents, entities, relationships and source evidence, creating institutional memory that teams and agents can draw on. Turn analysis into work your team can use. Generate editable memos, reports, presentations and spreadsheets, and connect workflows to the tools your business already uses. Explore document generation . The team you’ll be joining and impact you’ll have A small Platform team with a very wide remit: cloud, SRE, DevOps, developer experience, compliance, and the infrastructure behind our AI products. We run AWS first across multiple regions, with GCP and Azure alongside. Our model providers come through all three, so this is genuinely multi-cloud work. We're in the process of making everything faster, more reliable and nicer to work with, for enterprise customers who expect a lot. There are a number of compliance and big expansion projects on the horizon Our engineers lean heavily on AI coding agents and sandboxes. You’ll shape how that works across the company, giving people freedom while keeping us in control. Running the platform behind our AI workloads across Bedrock, Vertex AI and Azure, with a close eye on reliability and cost. Alongside that, compliance work and a spot on the on-call rotation. Who you are Strong AWS in production, ideally multi-region. Hands-on with GCP, with Azure a bonus. You understand how model consumption works through each cloud. Deep experience with Terraform, observability and CI/CD, and you write solid Python (Elixir is a bonus, or you’re keen to learn). A clear communicator who’s happy explaining technical things to a customer, not just to other engineers. Independent and comfortable with ambiguity. You find problems without being handed tickets, and you don’t mind when priorities flip from one week to the next. V7 champions equality and inclusion because diverse teams build better products. title: Senior People Partner - Content
description: About 9fin 9fin is the AI platform powering global debt markets — the world’s largest asset class at over $145 trillion. With proven product-market fit and strong, global market pull, 9fin is accelerating toward becoming the category-defining platform for debt markets worldwide. The opportunity Our People Partners are the eyes and ears of the organisation, embedded within their functional areas to be a sounding board for leaders, support managers and enable teams to thrive. The People Partnering team operate on a strategic and tactical level, ensuring the people elements are in place for teams to effectively deliver their strategic objectives (think org design, upskilling, succession planning) whilst also offering one on one support, both structured and ad hoc, to those who need it most. We're hiring an experienced, driven Senior People Partner to partner with our Chief Content Officer and the Content (Editorial, Legals, Credit, Distressed) team. Content is scaling fast across the UK and US, and we need a Senior People Partner who can move at pace, get to grips with what the team actually does, and hold their own with senior editorial and analytical leaders. You'll be fully embedded in the Content team, with a real voice in leadership meetings, editorial rituals and off-sites. You'll know the leads, managers and rising talent well enough to catch the people issues long before they show up in engagement scores or exit interviews. Every day is different, but here's an example of the kind of things you'll work on: Strategic Trusted advisor to your leaders : You'll be the first person Content leadership calls on anything people-related: the confidant, sounding board and thought partner they think alongside, not the person they update after the fact. That kind of trust is earned over time, through showing up and being willing to have the harder conversation when it matters. Right hand person to the CCO: You know how he thinks about content and his organisation, and are confident acting as his proxy with his leaders to get them to where they need to be. Locked in on what the team is trying to achieve : You know Content's goals, what its leaders and teams do. You bring solutions, not just observations, and follow them through to completion. Fully embedded in your team : You're in the rituals, Slack channels and meetings that matter, so you've got a real read on how the team actually works. You cut through the noise to name the actual issue and get it resolved quickly and respectfully. Catching things early : You join the dots across 1:1s, skips, engagement data and your own observations to surface people risks while they're still small and easy to fix. You coach leaders and managers to build the same instinct. Org design : You advise on org shape, spot gaps and flag future risk areas. You make sure the right people are doing the right jobs at the right level as Content scales across regions and coverage. Talent management : You know who the key talent is and you work with leaders to develop, stretch and reward them. You support leaders to identify their successors and build the development plans that get them ready. You work proactively with the Talent team on the pipelines for roles you can already see coming. Learning & development : You spot where Content teams need to grow — editorial craft, analytical rigour, management skill, leadership development — and you lead the training that plugs the gap. A big part of that is upskilling managers to handle people issues themselves, early and well, rather than escalating them to the CCO. You diagnose early, source or build the right thing, and hold a bar for what impact should look like once it's landed. Reward : You use solid data to inform our salary bands and keep compensation fair across the team, with D&I front of mind. You coach leaders and managers through promotion and salary reviews so decisions are thoughtful, equitable and defensible. Performance : You help leaders and managers get the best out of their teams, surfacing blockers, coaching through them, and making sure feedback and training actually land. You hold a high bar yourself and help leaders hold one too. Hands up for the bigger stuff : You take on projects that improve the People function as a whole, not just your patch. You scope them properly, influence stakeholders, manage the risks and dependencies, and ship on time. Tactical Employee Relations (ER) : Following UK employment law, navigating all employee relations within your business area, including but not limited to: managing Performance Improvement Plans (PIPs), resolving claims and grievances in line with policy, probation management, maternity and paternity cases, flexible working requests, conflict management and mediation, and any other employee-to-employee issue that comes up, both formally and informally. Embedding people products : Working with the wider Partnering team to embed our people products and systems, delivering training, championing adoption and being the go-to person for questions. Delivering product feedback to the wider team on a regular basis. Data : Pulling and analysing the right data to help managers and leaders make good calls and adding the context that turns numbers into something your leaders can actually use. Wellbeing support : 1:1 support to employees when they need it, and making sure they know what mental and physical health support is on offer. Supporting managers through those conversations too. Cultural ambassador : Working with leaders and managers to reinforce the right behaviours in teams. Being a role model yourself for our values and ways of working, especially as the London office grows. About You This role will be a great fit if you: Take real accountability for pushing back on leaders — not just flagging a concern and moving on, but staying with it until the right decision gets made. Can confidently challenge executives and their most senior leaders when it matters, as a true partner rather than a service function. Are properly curious about the business you support. You'll want to understand how Content produces its analysis, what makes a great desk, and what separates a good journalist from a world class one. You ask questions until you get to the real answer. Are a strong influencer, able to help others look at things from different perspectives and understand the 'why' behind decisions. Comfortable pushing back on leaders and managers when needed, and know when to step back and let them make their own call. Have significant experience partnering with content, editorial, research or analyst teams and can speak their language credibly. Have a bias to action: you see what needs doing and pick it up, rather than waiting to be asked. Use data to back your decisions and see what's coming, not just to describe what's already happened. Care about data integrity and have solid experience with the day-to-day people processes and onboarding a high-trust team relies on. Have a strong grasp of UK employment law and awareness of New York employment law to reach the right, compliant call in tricky ER situations autonomously. Sharp on policies and procedures. Can context-switch frequently and comfortably hold strategic and tactical work in the same day. Are a strong team player who partners closely with your fellow People Partners, Talent Partners and the wider People and Talent team so 9finners get the best experience of us collectively. Can operate autonomously and at pace in a fast-moving scale-up. Key Requirements: 5+ years of experience in HR, preferably in fast-paced environments (tech, fintech, or start-ups) Knowledge of UK employment laws and regulations Excellent organisational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously Familiarity with HRIS and ATS software (we use HiBob, Lattice and Ashby) Exceptional written and verbal communication skills; ability to interact with candidates, employees, and external stakeholders in a professional and approachable manner A people-first mindset with the ability to build strong relationships and offer guidance to employees at all levels Flexible and able to thrive in a fast-moving, dynamic start-up environment Proactive and collaborative approach A genuine interest in employee well-being and fostering a supportive, inclusive culture Compensation & Benefits Finance & Insurance Competitive base salary Equity options Pension with 9fin contributing 3% (employee contributions are uncapped) Private health insurance with dental and vision Time Off 25 vacation days per year Local public holidays (with option to exchange for alternative days) Work abroad for up to 3 months per year 1-month paid sabbatical after 5 years of service Enhanced parental leave and flexible working arrangements Growth & Culture Professional learning and development budget Bi-annual team socials Summer and Winter company-wide events Hybrid Policy 9fin is a hybrid company, and the office is a regular part of how we work. description: <div class="content-intro"><h2>Who <strong>We Are</strong></h2> <p>Lightning AI is the company behind PyTorch Lightning. Founded in 2019, we build an end-to-end platform for developing, training, and deploying AI systems—designed to take ideas from research to production with less friction.</p> <p>Through our merger with Voltage Park, a neocloud and AI Factory, Lightning AI combines developer-first software with cost-efficient, large-scale compute. We create scalable systems, simplify complexity, and use AI and automation to amplify our impact.</li> </ul> <div class="c-message_actions__container c-message__actions"> </div></div><h2>About the Role</h2> <p>Lightning AI is seeking a <strong>Senior Infrastructure Software Engineer</strong> to join our Infrastructure Engineering team.</p> <p>Our Infrastructure Engineering team builds the software systems that operate and manage Lightning AI’s large-scale GPU and bare-metal infrastructure. We develop services, APIs, tooling, and automation that bridge the gap between our physical infrastructure and the systems our customers depend on for AI/ML training, inference, and HPC workloads.</p> <p>In this role, you will build production software and automation that support infrastructure throughout its lifecycle, from provisioning and bring-up through monitoring, maintenance, and decommissioning. You will design systems that enable engineers and software to interact programmatically with thousands of servers, storage systems, and high-performance networks, reducing manual operations and making infrastructure management more reliable, repeatable, and scalable.</p> <p>This is a software-first infrastructure role that combines strong software engineering with Linux systems and hardware-aware infrastructure automation. You will work closely with teams across Infrastructure, Networking, Data Center Operations, and Platform Engineering to bring new capacity online and continuously improve how we operate our infrastructure at scale.</p> <p><em>This role may be fully remote within the U.S., or hybrid out of one of our office hubs (NYC, SF, Seattle, or London), with occasional team and company offsites. We are not able to provide visa sponsorship for this position at this time.</em></p> <h2><strong>What You Will Do</strong></h2> <h3><strong>Infrastructure Software & Automation</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Design, build, and operate production services, APIs, tooling, and automation for managing large-scale bare-metal and GPU infrastructure</li> <li>Build and extend software systems that support infrastructure provisioning, configuration, monitoring, and lifecycle management</li> <li>Develop reliable automation that reduces manual operational work and improves the consistency and scalability of infrastructure management</li> <li>Build tools and interfaces that enable engineers and other systems to interact programmatically with physical infrastructure</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Provisioning & Lifecycle Management</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Build and extend systems for server discovery, provisioning, configuration, validation, and lifecycle management</li> <li>Automate infrastructure bring-up and capacity deployment across large fleets of compute systems</li> <li>Integrate software and automation with hardware management and provisioning systems</li> <li>Improve tooling and workflows for managing infrastructure throughout its production lifecycle</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Reliability & Observability</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Build telemetry, logging, and observability capabilities that provide visibility into the health of our infrastructure</li> <li>Develop tools and automation to identify, diagnose, and respond to infrastructure and hardware issues</li> <li>Translate recurring operational issues and hardware failure modes into improvements to software, tooling, and automation</li> <li>Improve the reliability and scalability of infrastructure operations as the fleet grows</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Architecture & Collaboration</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Partner with Network, Infrastructure Operations, Data Center, Platform Engineering, and other teams to define requirements and build new infrastructure capabilities</li> <li>Participate in architectural discussions and help define the technical direction of Lightning AI’s infrastructure software</li> <li>Make pragmatic design decisions that balance reliability, scalability, simplicity, and speed of execution</li> <li>Write clear design documents and technical documentation and contribute to engineering best practices</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Who You Are</strong></h2> <h3><strong>Required Qualifications</strong></h3> <ul> <li>5+ years of professional software engineering, infrastructure engineering, or related experience</li> <li>Strong software engineering fundamentals and experience building production backend systems in Python or similar object-oriented programming languages</li> <li>Strong experience with Linux in production environments</li> <li>Experience building APIs, tooling, or automation for managing infrastructure at scale</li> <li>Familiarity with containerization and orchestration concepts</li> <li>Understanding of HPC and bare-metal infrastructure fundamentals, including provisioning and out-of-band management</li> <li>Ability to navigate ambiguity and make pragmatic architecture decisions while building for long-term reliability and scale</li> <li>Experience working in a startup or other fast-paced environment with a high degree of ownership and autonomy</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Ideal Experience</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Experience with bare-metal hardware troubleshooting and provisioning, including technologies such as PXE/iPXE, BMC, Redfish, or IPMI, particularly with Dell hardware</li> <li>Experience with GPU servers, either in bare-metal environments or under virtualization</li> <li>Experience with network switches, routers, and firewalls, particularly SONiC switches, Palo Alto firewalls, or Juniper Networks</li> <li>Experience with high-performance storage systems, particularly VAST</li> <li>Experience supporting AI/ML or HPC infrastructure at scale</li> </ul> <h2> </h2> <h2>Compensation</h2><div class="content-pay-transparency"><div class="pay-input"><div class="description"><p>We are committed to offering competitive description: <div class="content-intro"><h2><strong>About AlphaSense: </strong></h2> <p style="text-align: justify;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">AlphaSense is the AI platform redefining market intelligence and workflow orchestration, trusted by thousands of leading organizations to drive faster, more confident decisions in business and finance. For more information, visit <span><a href="http://www.alpha-sense.com" target="_blank">www.alpha-sense.com</a></span>. Come join us.</span></p></div><p><strong>Location: London (In office presence required) </strong></p> <p><strong>About the Team:</strong></p> <p>The Customer Success organisation is composed of four teams: pre-sales, customer success managers, account management and support. We have 100M+ monthly open source downloads, 6,000+ active LangSmith customers, and 5 of the Fortune 10 use LangSmith in production (+ 35% of the Fortune 500 overall), including teams at Klarna, Clay, Coinbase, Workday, Lyft, Cloudflare, Harvey, Rippling, Vanta, LinkedIn, Monday.com, Nvidia, and Bridgewater. What you'll own: Regional demand strategy and pipeline: Build the EMEA demand plan: which markets, which segments, which channels, and what each is expected to return Own an EMEA pipeline target and report against it sourced and influenced, by channel and by market Decide how the regional demand budget gets allocated for localized programs. title: VP, Strategic Finance
description: Team: Finance (G&A) Reports to: Chief Financial Officer Location: London, Amsterdam or Stockholm. Remote-first, with travel as and when needed About Nivoda Nivoda is the B2B marketplace rebuilding how the jewellery industry works. We connect independent jewellery retailers with a global network of diamond and gemstone suppliers, so a jeweller in Denver or Devon can source from anywhere in the world without the cost, risk, and hassle of doing it the old way. We handle the logistics, the payments, and the quality checks, the messy middle that used to put global sourcing out of reach for small businesses. Today we process over $300M in transactions a year in a $350B industry that still runs largely on personal relationships and paperwork. We are growing quickly, we are backed by leading investors, and we are only getting started. We built Nivoda so every jeweller, whatever their size and wherever they are, has access to the same global supply, pricing and tools as the biggest players. Why this role & why now You will sit on the Extended Leadership Team, report to the CFO, and own how Nivoda plans, reports and is funded. You will present to the board, investors and our receivables lender yourself, work directly with the CFO on equity and debt financing, and build a finance function that runs on routine rather than heroics. This is for someone who wants to lead a team and shape the company’s financial story, not only model it. What you will own Planning and forecasting. You own the annual budget, quarterly reforecast and long-range plan, plus scenario and funding cases for the C-suite and board. You are accountable for forecast accuracy against agreed tolerances, and for an honest post-mortem whether we miss or overachieve. Board, investor and lender reporting. You own the monthly board pack and the numbers behind it, plus materials for existing and prospective investors and our receivables lender, including covenant reporting and onsite diligence. You present to these audiences yourself and you are their first call for analytical questions. The aim is that they trust the numbers without the CFO needing to vouch for them. Corporate finance. You build the models and documentation for equity and debt financing, analyse term sheets, work with the People team on cap table and option pool, and support the CFO on transactions. Commercial and unit economics. You own cohort economics, customer lifetime value, geographic and segment profitability, and the return on marketing and sales spend. With the CRO’s organisation, you build quota and commission models so targets, incentives and the forecast point at the same numbers. Business partnering. You partner with Product and Engineering, Fulfilment, Fintech and the commercial teams on build versus buy, hiring cases, pricing and fee experiments, and capital allocation. The function says yes, no or not yet, with a model behind it. Leading the function. You lead the team: hiring, onboarding, objectives, development and performance, including written objectives and regular structured feedback for each person. You set the review standard and deliverables calendar, agree data contracts with the Data team, and own the tooling (Snowflake, NetSuite, ThoughtSpot, Claude and the modelling stack). We measure the function on on-time delivery, errors caught internally rather than by the audience, forecast accuracy, and how many people can produce each recurring deliverable. What good looks like First 90 days. You have taken over the monthly pack and the reforecast without the investors noticing a handover. You have met your leadership-team peers and told the CFO what you would change and in what order. 90 to 180 days. The monthly pack, FP&A-approved numbers and lender reporting land on the agreed date, each with a named owner and a written process. No board, lender or investor number has needed restating. The first version of the business line P&Ls is delivered at day 180. Twelve months. The function delivers month-end and board commitments without you or the CFO stepping in, including when you are away. A team member has delivered a new analytical capability end to end. FP&A and the Data team work from one set of metric definitions. Board members, lenders and the leadership team rely on the numbers without asking the CFO to vouch for them. The standard A finance team has no quota. The thing it sells is trust, and trust is earned with accuracy a bar above the rest of the company and delivery on the date promised. Three things must not fail in this role. Timeliness : deadlines are commitments, not targets. Quality : every external-facing number reconciles to a primary source and has been reviewed by someone other than its author before it leaves the team. Capacity : within reason, not a constraint. The function absorbs the demands of a 450-person company by organising, prioritising and delegating. If capacity is a hard limit, you make the case for a hire or an automation with numbers, rather than letting the work slip. That is a high bar, and it is fair because the role comes with the means to meet it: people to delegate to, authority over how the team's week is spent, a budget line, and the standing to say no to the business with the CFO's backing. What you bring A background in investment banking, FP&A or venture capital, building models that senior stakeholders made decisions on. You have led a team, directly or through managers, and you want the management part of this role. You have presented to boards, investors or lenders as the person answering the question, not the person who built the slide. A working understanding of marketplace dynamics: two-sided liquidity, take rates, usage-based revenue without a contract, and what FX does to all of it. Complex cohort modelling is native to you. You are comfortable in Snowflake and a modern BI tool, you treat AI tooling as part of the stack, and you would rather fix the pipeline than reformat the output every month. You are calm under pressure, low on ego and allergic to spin. You tell people the uncomfortable thing early. Useful but not required: receivables financing or lender reporting, a multi-jurisdiction group, NetSuite, or a business that trades physical goods across borders. What this role is not It is not a bigger version of a senior analyst role, and it is not where every difficult model gets built personally. If you are at your best as the smartest modeler in the room and would rather stay that way, this will frustrate you. It is also not a quiet seat. Month-end, board and lender deadlines are fixed, a 450-person company makes a lot of demands on finance, and you will regularly be the one saying no, with the CFO’s backing. If you want a purely advisory or slower-paced role, this isn’t it. What we offer Nivoda is a place where smart, driven people do the best work of their careers. We move fast, give ownership early, and don’t have layers of bureaucracy slowing things down. If you see a problem, you can fix it. Our current benefits include: Flexible working hours and a vibrant, remote-first company culture Unlimited holiday allowance Participation in our equity programme Genuine opportunities for growth: we promote from within and invest in your development The chance to join during an expansion phase and shape how Nivoda operates at scale Interview Process Screening conversation with Talent Acquisition Structured career-history interview with Hiring Manager Focus interview: you present a case study to a panel from Finance and the leadership team Final conversation with the C-suite Equal opportunity Nivoda is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment where everyone can do their best work. We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, experiences and perspectives. If you meet most of this description and not all of it, apply anyway and tell us where the gaps are. Please submit your CV in English. Not the right role? Join our Talent Pool If this isn’t quite the right fit but you’re excited about what Nivoda is building, we’d still love to hear from you. Join our Talent Pool and we’ll reach out when the right opportunity comes along. nivoda.com/careers Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Patent Engineer (Life Sciences)
description: The way companies innovate is broken. The systems built to create and protect ideas can’t keep up with the pace of change. Today, 90% of S&P 500 company value is intangible (e.g., in intellectual property) - yet R&D and IP teams spend half their time buried in manual work , sifting through patents and paperwork instead of pushing the frontier forward. The tools of creating and protecting are stuck in the past. We’re here to fix that. Ankar is building the R&D tools for the AI era and defining what applied research will look like in the next 20 years . We’re building infrastructure and product experiences our customers rely on every day. You’ll translate messy, ambiguous problems into clean, dependable software—and you’ll do it at the cutting-edge of AI. We’re at an inflection point: We’ve raised >$24M to date from Tier-1 VCs like Atomico, Index Ventures, Norrsken, Daphni, and angels like the Founder of Hugging Face, CEO from Datadog, and Leaders from DeepMind and OpenAI. We’re already working with the world’s most innovative companies including Fortune 500 company L’Oréal and global law firm Vorys Expanding our world-class team with alumni from Palantir, Amazon, and BCG to tackle the $1T+ innovation market . We’re just getting started. What you’ll be doing We’re looking for a patent professional with deep large-molecule life sciences expertise who can bridge product development, engineering and IP protection. You’ll work hands-on with pharmaceutical and biotech customers to design AI-powered patent solutions that understand the nuances of biologics—including antibodies, proteins, peptides, nucleic acids, vaccines and cell and gene therapies—and the conventions that govern their patent protection. Build life sciences-specific patent products: Partner with product and engineering teams to develop AI tools tailored to large-molecule patents—from protein and antibody sequence analysis to biologics claim generation, sequence-listing support and prior-art searching across life sciences databases. Embed with pharmaceutical and biotech customers: Work directly with in-house patent counsel and prosecution teams to design, prototype and deploy high-value proofs of concept for large-molecule patent workflows. Shape product development with biologics expertise: Translate complex large-molecule patent challenges into product requirements, ensuring our AI understands sequence data, CDR and epitope definitions, functional claim language, sequence variants, experimental data and biologics drafting conventions. Drive customer success in large-molecule patents: Lead technical sessions with patent professionals to ensure our products deliver measurable value across biologics patent portfolios. Identify emerging biologics patent opportunities: Recognize evolving needs across therapeutic antibodies, recombinant proteins, vaccines, nucleic acid technologies, cell and gene therapies, biologics formulations and regulatory IP strategy. What we’re looking for Large-molecule patent expertise: At least two years of experience in biologics patent prosecution, pharmaceutical or biotech IP, or other large-molecule-focused patent work, with a strong understanding of the patent lifecycle from invention disclosure through prosecution, grant and enforcement. Technical life sciences foundation: Strong knowledge of molecular biology, biochemistry, immunology or a related discipline, including an understanding of protein and nucleic acid sequences, antibody structure and function, biologics development, and how these translate into patentable subject matter. Strong biologics drafting skills: Experience developing claim strategies for antibodies, proteins, nucleic acids or other biologic modalities, with an understanding of written-description, enablement, sequence-listing and functional-claiming requirements. Builder’s mindset: You thrive in ambiguity, iterate quickly on prototypes and enjoy creating order from complexity. You can move seamlessly between high-level patent strategy and detailed biologics claim construction. Extreme ownership: You anticipate problems, take responsibility for outcomes and consistently deliver. This is how you grow—and how we win. [Bonus points]: Experience at a patent law firm representing pharmaceutical or biotech clients; in-house patent counsel experience at a pharmaceutical or biotech company; expertise in emerging modalities such as antibody-drug conjugates, bispecific antibodies, RNA therapeutics or cell and gene therapies; or an advanced life sciences degree combined with patent training. This role is not for you if... You need a highly structured environment, a predefined playbook, regular working hours, or a schedule that never requires travel. We operate with high autonomy and ownership, expect our team to go above and beyond, be obsessed with our mission and thrive in ambiguity rather than wait for direction. You prefer long planning cycles and certainty before acting. We move quickly, ship often, and adapt based on customer feedback and new information. You want to manage the work rather than do the work. We're builders first, and everyone is expected to contribute directly to creating exceptional products. You take it personally when ideas are challenged, priorities shift, or work gets redirected. We care more about finding the right answer than defending a particular one. What we put behind our people Building at the frontier takes exceptional people. We invest accordingly. Health Insurance : Full private health & dental coverage for you and your dependents. Pension: Flexible pension scheme with up to 5% employer matching on qualifying earnings. Food on us: Team lunches twice a week, plus dinner when working late in the office. Cycle to work: Green Commute initiative scheme (up to £3k) to help you get a new bike tax-free. Way we work: We combine deep, in-person collaboration (3 days/week in our Shoreditch office) with flexibility and trust. What matters is ownership, impact, and results, not where you work from. Represent regional customer needs internally and share market learning with the CRO and functional leaders, contributing to consistent GTM practices across Dust. Market-specific focus United Kingdom Build on early customer and partner traction. Use customer referrals, targeted events, and focused market experiments to build qualified pipeline and strengthen local customer proof. What we’re looking for A proven sales professional who has grown from individual contributor into people leadership, with 5+ years leading B2B software sales and coaching regional sales teams and a hands-on understanding of how to help reps succeed in-market. You've owned a market or segment revenue number end to end, not just a team's quota. You've built pipeline through functions you didn't manage, such as marketing, partners and pre-sales, and you've made real calls about where capacity and budget go, including between direct sales and partners Ability to lead by example in priority opportunities, from discovery through close. Experience building pipeline and customer relationships in a market where the brand or sales motion is still developing. A disciplined approach to forecasting and performance feedback, paired with high EQ and a genuinely supportive leadership style. An appetite for building, testing, and refining a market over multiple quarters while balancing near-term results with durable growth. Location We're prioritizing building our team with an in-person culture at our offices in Paris, London, San Francisco, and New York because we value the magic that happens when talented people work closely together. What's missing is the product layer where AI meets how companies actually work. That's what we're building: the infrastructure that lets any team turn scattered knowledge and tools into coordinated execution with agents they build, own, and run themselves. We use Dust ourselves every day. We get to shape how humans and agents collaborate while solving our own problems with the product we ship. That loop is rare, and it's why we move fast. Comfort using performance data to assess partner activity, report results, and adjust course. Excellent written, verbal, and listening skills, with the ability to work across partner organizations and internal teams. A hands-on, organized working style that keeps multiple relationships and commitments moving at once. UK-based, with flexibility to travel across the UK and attend occasional evening or weekend partner events. Nice to haves A background in strategy consulting or investment banking. Experience creating B2B pipeline through partner networks, executive events, hospitality, or account-based campaigns. Familiarity with UK small and medium-sized businesses and the finance leaders who buy and use Ramp's products. title: Solutions Architect
description: <div class="content-intro"><h4><strong>Who We Are</strong></h4> <p>WPP Enterprise Solutions designs, builds, and operates the growth systems that competitive businesses rely on. In a world where Al is reshaping how companies drive growth, we lead clients in business transformation and marketing modernization, connecting strategy directly to execution. Our 12,000 experts in engineering and platforms, commerce, consulting, content transformation, CRM, and CX work within a unified global operating unit across 40+ markets. WPP Enterprise Solutions works alongside best-in-class partners including Adobe, AWS, Braze, Google, Microsoft, Salesforce, and Shopify, as well as innovators in AI, to deliver growth solutions tailored to the needs of our clients’ businesses. VML, part of WPP, supports WPP Enterprise Solutions by helping brands activate transformation through creativity and experience.</p></div><p>We are looking for a Principal Solutions Architect to join us on a permanent basis. <br><br>Our Commerce & Technology division helps leading global brands design, build and run the commerce platforms behind their growth. We are seeking a Principal Solutions Architect to lead solution in business pursuits and account growth, across enterprise commerce. </p> <p>You will be the person in the room who understands how the whole commerce estate fits together, from web storefront and mobile app through commerce platform, data and ERP.   You will turn that understanding into a clear case for business value, win the trust of senior client stakeholders, and when it helps, build a working demonstration to show them what good looks like.<strong> <br> </strong></p> <p><strong>Key Responsibilities </strong></p> <ul> <li>Architect Enterprise Commerce: Design end to end commerce solutions across Adobe Commerce, Salesforce Commerce Cloud, Shopify, HCL and composable (MACH) solutions, spanning web, mobile apps, data and back office systems.  </li> </ul> <ul> <li>Lead with value: Frame every solution around commercial outcomes, cost and return, so clients can see clear cases for change rather than a technology shopping list.  </li> </ul> <ul> <li>Serve as an outward-facing, energetic leader who runs workshops, participates in governance, and collaborates with commercial teams to identify and shape technical growth opportunities. </li> </ul> <p><strong>What you’ll be doing </strong></p> <ul> <li>Client Engagement and Discovery: Build trusted relationships with senior business and technology stakeholders. Run discovery workshops, ask the questions that uncover what really matters, and cut through complexity to the decisions that count. </li> </ul> <ul> <li>Solution Design and Architecture: Produce clear architecture diagrams and solution designs covering storefront, mobile apps, commerce platform, search, content, order management, product information, payments, data and other integrations. Recommend the right platform and approach for each client rather than defaulting to one. </li> </ul> <ul> <li>Platform Selection and Replatforming: Guide clients through platform choices and migrations, including the move from monolithic to composable, weighing total cost of ownership, speed to market, risk and operating model. </li> </ul> <ul> <li>Data, Integration and Back Office: Get into the detail of how commerce connects to ERP (such as SAP, Microsoft Dynamics or Oracle), order management, warehouse, customer data and analytics, and design integration patterns that hold up at enterprise scale. </li> </ul> <ul> <li>Mobile and Omnichannel: Shape mobile app strategy and architecture (native, cross platform and headless) alongside web, store and marketplace channels, so the customer experience is joined up. </li> </ul> <ul> <li>Business Case and Value: Build business cases, value models and roadmaps that link technology decisions to revenue, conversion, margin and cost to serve. </li> </ul> <ul> <li>Demonstrations and Proofs of Concept: Stand up demo storefronts and prototypes quickly, such as a Shopify store or a composable proof of concept, to show clients what is possible and take risk out of their decisions. </li> </ul> <ul> <li>Proposals and Pitches: Own the solution story, architecture, assumptions and effort estimates in proposals, and present them with confidence at pitch. </li> </ul> <ul> <li>Handover and Delivery Assurance: Make sure what is sold can be delivered, with a clean handover to delivery teams and continued involvement through mobilisation. </li> </ul> <ul> <li>Market and Partner Leadership: Stay across the commerce market, including cloud (AWS, GCP), AI in commerce and agentic commerce.
