title: Staff Product Manager
description: Location: Chancery Lane, London (Office-based 4 days) The Mission At Fyxer, we believe the only sustainable competitive advantage for a startup is the quality and speed of execution. We are looking for a Product Lead who operates like a Staff PM: someone who owns our most important product bets end-to-end, from ambiguous problem space to shipped outcome. You combine sharp product judgment with hands-on discovery skills, and you measure yourself on commercial impact, not output. We're not looking for someone to write specs and manage a backlog. We want someone who helps us think better, decide better, and ship better. The goal isn't more process, it's higher quality decisions made faster. You will work directly with our Head of Product, CTO, founders and senior engineers to shape what we build and why. What you will own You will not hand anything over. You will own the bet from first insight to shipped impact. Own discovery through delivery for our most important product bets, from early ambiguity to validated direction to launched product Work directly with engineers and founders from the start of any initiative as the accountable product owner, not a coordinator Frame the problem, define the hypothesis, and choose the fastest route to signal: interviews, prototypes, fake doors, experiments, or just shipping and measuring Translate messy qualitative and quantitative signals into clear product direction, then drive that direction through to execution Set success metrics, make the call on when there's enough signal to build, and own the outcome either way Embed structured learning loops into how we operate so insight compounds over time Raise the bar of product thinking across the team: coach others, introduce lightweight frameworks, and get the whole company closer to customers Who you are You are a full-stack product thinker. Outcome owner: You connect user behaviour to funnels, retention, and revenue. You think in bets and expected value, not feature lists, and you hold yourself accountable to results. Discovery-strong: Genuinely fluent across qualitative research, behavioural insight, and experimentation. You generate strong signal quickly and pick the right method for the decision at hand, rather than outsourcing the thinking. Engineering partner: You work shoulder to shoulder with engineers, translating insight into crisp problem framing and practical tradeoffs. Engineers want to work with you because you make the work clearer, not slower. Decision oriented: You know when there's enough signal to move. You sharpen hypotheses, clarify thinking, and make confident calls under uncertainty. You'd rather ship and learn than perfect and wait. Force multiplier: Your impact shows up in how the whole team operates. You build repeatable systems for discovery and decision-making that outlast any single project. The Role You will be the senior product voice on our most important initiatives, working directly with the Head of Product, CPGO, founders, and senior engineers. This is not a support function. You will be embedded in high impact work from day one, with real authority over what we build and why. You will operate at speed. We care about generating signal quickly, making informed decisions, and shipping fast. You are comfortable working with imperfect information and tightening your thinking as you go. You will move fluidly across the full product lifecycle. Some weeks you will be deep in user interviews or pressure testing a major bet, other weeks you will be in the detail with engineers getting something over the line. You will have significant autonomy. We expect strong judgment, clear communication, and ownership of outcomes. If there are specific tools you believe are critical to moving faster or generating better signal, we will support that. We want you to design the right setup, not work around constraints. Why Fyxer? We are intentional about our team. We believe a small, exceptional team working with extreme focus will always outperform a large, bloated organization. Autonomy: We hire people who want ownership and then we actually give it to them. Velocity: You will be fast-tracked into senior responsibilities far earlier than at a traditional company. Scale: We are on track to hit $100M in revenue by the end of 2026. This is a rare opportunity to join a high-growth rocket ship at the foundational stage. #LI-FYX Compensation: £140K – £180K • £140K – £180K Equity • £140K – £180K • £140K – £180K Equity Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Deployment Strategist
description: The Role Procurement and supply chain is a $3 trillion market still running on outdated systems and manual processes. Magentic is changing that. We’re building a new generation of agentic AI that works inside the world’s largest and most complex organisations, backed by Sequoia and built by a team from OpenAI, Meta, Revolut, NASA and McKinsey. We’re early, moving fast and already solving real problems for global enterprises. As a Deployment Strategist , you’ll be at the heart of making that happen. You’ll take what we build and turn it into real-world impact for our customers, owning engagements from initial scoping through to live deployment. You’ll sit at the intersection of product, commercial and customer, figuring out what needs to be built, how we make it work and how we deliver meaningful outcomes. You won’t just be deploying Magentic, you’ll help shape how we work with customers as we scale. What You’ll Do You’ll have a huge impact on both Magentic’s commercial success and our product direction. This is a rare opportunity to help build a rocket ship. As we grow, you could develop into product management or engineering, into a leader in our customer engineering space, even into sales, as you discover your strengths and interests. Own deployments end-to-end —design the rollout strategy at household-name enterprises, run the programme, and change course decisively when the approach isn't landing. Hold the senior relationships —be the Director and VP sponsor's first call, run steering governance, and take on the difficult conversations. Find the value nobody has scoped —go looking beyond the signed scope, prove new use cases with the customer, and build the case for what we sell them next. Define best practice for AI deployment —set the bar on your deployments, and turn this into processes that the rest of the org can use to scale. Shape our roadmap —bring product and engineering the problem, the customer evidence, and a view on what we should build. You Might Be a Great Fit if You Have 5+ years of experience in a customer-facing delivery or product role Have managed complex, multi-stakeholder projects at senior levels and kept them moving when priorities shifted Think commercially: you track outcomes, not just activities, and you understand how successful deployments translate into revenue Are energised by early-stage ambiguity — you can create structure where none exists and make decisions with incomplete information Communicate exceptionally well, both in the room with a VP and in a written handover to a colleague Bonus Points Have experience deploying AI, automation, or data products inside large organisations Are familiar with procurement, supply chain, or finance functions in enterprise settings Compensation and Benefits At Magentic, we recognise and reward the talent that drives our success. We offer: Competitive Equity : play a real part in Magentic’s upside A salary of £100-110k Enhanced parental leave 25 days holiday exc bank holidays, plus an extra day for our Christmas shutdown In-office lunches provided Salary sacrifice pension and nursery schemes Hybrid London HQ (4 days per week onsite, with flex if you have appointments etc) Annual team retreat —a fully-funded off-site to recharge, bond, and build Our Interview Process We can move quickly through these stages, so let us know if you have any timelines we need to meet. Initial call (30 mins) : this first step is an opportunity for you to hear more about Magentic and the role, and for us to learn more about how your experience aligns with the role. Skills interview (45 mins): in this step, we'll ask you to prepare a presentation and take Q&A. In-person interview (half-day, paid): for the final step, we invite you to come meet the team in-person. We find this is the best way for candidates to get a sense of what working at Magentic is like. This day will include a culture interview, founder interview and a presentation task / discussion with the team. Equal Opportunities and Accommodations Statement At Magentic, our mission is to build AI that helps solve some of the world's most complex real world problems. We believe building a diverse workforce will be the key to solving this for our customers. Magentic is committed to creating a truly inclusive team and we’re proud to be an equal-opportunity employer. As we grow, we're intentional about building teams with a broad range of backgrounds, experiences and viewpoints, recognising that this leads to better ideas, stronger collaboration and better outcomes for our customers therefore we strongly encourage applications from all backgrounds and cultures to apply. We recognise that some groups remain underrepresented within the industry and are committed to creating an environment that celebrates and supports everyone. Everyone works differently, and we want to ensure our interview process gives you the best chance to show us what you can do. If you require any reasonable adjustments or accommodations, please let us know and we'll work with you to make the process accessible. Responsible AI Statement At Magentic, we are committed to developing artificial intelligence that benefits humanity. We push the limits of AI's capabilities and are dedicated to its responsible and safe deployment. Recognising the profound impact of AI, we ensure that its development is centred around human needs and safety, incorporating a wide array of perspectives to fulfil our mission. title: Trust Communications
description: TL;DR Millions of people build on Lovable, from software that runs new businesses to the tools that power existing ones. At the center of it all is trust. That’s why we’re looking for an exceptional storyteller to spearhead Lovable’s trust, safety, and security communications efforts. Why Lovable For decades, the ability to build software belonged to a tiny fraction of the population: the people with the credentials, the technical training, the access. Everyone else had to wait, or pay, or give up. Lovable is the counterargument: We exist for the people with ideas who were locked out of software creation until now. Over 70 million projects have been built on the platform. Hundreds of thousands of people pay for it. The product handles real infrastructure, not only prototypes: authentication, databases, payments, and deployment. People run real businesses on Lovable, which means the stakes are real too. The comms challenge: when anyone can build, the platform has to be safe for everyone who does, and they need to know it. That takes someone who can tell the story of how we think about topics like safety, security, and reliability before anyone asks, and who can be honest, precise, and fast when the questions come up anyway. What you’ll do Build and own Lovable’s trust narrative. You’ll own Lovable’s trust narrative in earned, new, and owned media, proactively telling the story of how we think about security, privacy, and safety. You’ll shape the stories that highlight our commitments and ensure we show up in the conversations where trust in AI platforms is being decided right now. Be the comms partner to our security and trust leadership. You’ll develop and own the spokesperson platforms for our CISO and other senior leaders who speak on our trust efforts, identifying and preparing them for on-stage and media opportunities. You’ll help them become recognized voices on topics of trust in AI software creation. Own incident communications, end to end. When something doesn’t go as planned, you’re the incident comms lead who ensures clear and swift communications for every audience that needs to hear from us, including media, customers, and employees. You’ll build and run the playbook that lets us move faster each time. Build relationships with relevant media and creators. You’ll know the voices who matter most in telling our trust story, and you’ll make sure those relationships exist before we need them. Who you are You’ve done trust, safety, or security communications. You have proven comms experience across a variety of trust-related topics, from AI safety to security. You’ve worked on or alongside security, privacy, or trust and safety teams. You have real incident experience. You’ve been the incident comms lead more than once, and you’ve probably written a playbook along the way. You bring the attention to detail, precision, speed, and judgment an incident requires. You have strong media relationships in the tech and AI ecosystem. Security and trust reporters, analysts, policy-adjacent media, perhaps even researchers. You know who they are, what they care about, and how to earn their attention honestly. You’re voraciously curious. You don’t need to be an engineer, but you need to be willing to understand how a platform like ours works well enough to describe an incident accurately and explain a safety decision without hand-waving. You write clearly and have keen attention to detail. Your writing is precise, human, and accessible, even when the subject matter is complex or the situation is sensitive. You also catch things others may miss. You’re calm, hands-on, and low-ego. You’ll draft the statements, build the media list, prep the spokesperson, and coordinate across teams yourself. You thrive in environments where the plan often changes and the pace is relentless. You have 6+ years of experience in communications , with significant time spent on trust and safety, security, or incident communications at a technology company. We care more about the right years than the number of them: judgment under pressure matters more than tenure. What you need to know This is a strategic but hands-on role with both proactive and reactive components. That means you’ll need to be comfortable being the person who’s on call when something breaks, while simultaneously leading the charge on work that moves our trust narrative forward. The role itself lives at the intersection of several functions, and you’ll be the one finding the red thread among all that’s happening so we can tell a cohesive story externally. Lovable is a European company with a global audience. The trust story has to resonate outside of Silicon Valley and our home turf in Stockholm. Wherever you sit, you’ll work across time zones and build relationships with the teams whose work you’re talking about. Finally: joining Lovable Comms means you’re deeply curious, data-driven, and not extremely precious about role boundaries. You find ways to work smarter with AI, to measure what matters, and to step into work that isn’t technically “yours” when the moment calls for it. title: Director of Self Serve
description: What do we do? Paddle offers digital product companies a completely different approach to their payment infrastructure. Instead of assembling and maintaining a complex stack of payments-related apps and services, we’re a Merchant of Record for our customers. That means we take away 100% of the pain of payment fragmentation. It’s faster, safer, cheaper, and, above all, way better. We’re backed by investors including KKR, FTV Capital, Kindred, Notion, and 83North and serve over 10,000 software sellers in 245 territories globally. The Role Self-serve today represents a meaningful part of Paddle's revenue. This role owns the commercial mandate to grow that significantly. Not just to run self-serve, but to build the strategy for where and how it scales, and execute against it. We're hiring a Director of Self-Serve to take full commercial ownership of Paddle's self-serve motion, running and scaling it as a business line. Self-serve is a material and fast-moving part of our revenue, and it needs an owner who thinks in unit economics, not just funnel metrics. You'll set the strategic direction, and work across Finance, Product, Engineering, Demand Generation, Partnerships, and RevOps to align everyone behind it. Getting this right is a genuinely cross-functional endeavour, and your ability to bring people with you will be just as important as your commercial acumen. You'll operate with a small, focused team including engineering capacity. This is a role for someone who wants to build and run the engine hands on, not manage through layers. What you'll do Own the line. Carry the commercial number for self-serve end to end, from acquisition through adoption, to revenue and net retention. Own the unit economics, and how they improve. Set the strategy. Form a clear commercial view of where self-serve creates value, ensure Finance and Product alignment, and translate it into a plan the business can execute against. Own activation and time-to-value. Evolve who and how we onboard through self-serve, how we nurture them through lifecycle stages, and the in-product experience that gets them to value fast. Increasing volume while decreasing time-to-value, not trading one for the other. You fundamentally approach the self-serve experience as a product, running structured discovery and experimentation, not defaulting to only marketing levers. Shape the demand. Define the customer profile that makes the economics work and work collaboratively with Demand Generation on the targeting you need, co-owning a single funnel against a shared ICP. Orchestrate cross-functionally. Codify the work into clear streams with clear owners, influence the Product, Engineering, and Risk roadmaps, and run a regular business cadence that keeps people aligned on priorities and impact. Deepen partner integrations. Work hand-in-glove with Partnerships to turn distribution relationships into deep well-integrated channels, owning the commercial outcome of partner-sourced volume. Build and run the engine. Design and run the experimentation, tooling, and tracking to improve funnel codification, time-to-value, activation, and conversion using AI where it raises velocity and quality, applied to the right customer. As the motion scales, you'll shape the team around it. Make the economics stack up. Working closely with finance you own self-serve pricing and packaging as a lever, to ensure profitable scale. How you operate Go get the answer yourself. When something doesn't add up, you pull the data, run the analysis, and don't wait to be handed a conclusion. Self-reliance is core to how you operate, not a fallback when support isn't available. You interrogate, not just observe. Live the ‘five whys’ principle, with the ability to take a plausible looking number, trend, signal and stress-test it until you've found the actual driver, not the first explanation that fits. You default to hypothesis and experiment before you default to opinion or output, treating the funnel as something to be iteratively shaped, not just optimised within. Given a mission, you don't let go of it. You have a real hunger to find and unlock value you believe is there, working through blockers, organisational, technical, or data. We'd love to hear from you if you are Deeply experienced in a PLG or self-serve motion in a high-growth tech business, where you've built and owned the funnel rather than a sales-assisted or enterprise motion, and have been accountable for the number, not adjacent to it. A commercial operator who has owned a revenue line, channel, or segment. Someone who operates in founder mode with the instinct to understand the economics, not just the funnel beneath them. Role As a Web Frontend Engineer, you will build the core web experiences, including Chat, Notes, Calendar, Docs and Sheets. You will own complex, highly interactive product surfaces from architecture through implementation, working closely with product, design, backend and AI engineers to make AI a native part of how users communicate, write, organise and work. What You'll Own Build major web experiences across Chat, Notes, Calendar, Docs, and Sheets. Develop complex interactions including real-time messaging, collaborative editing, rich-text editing, scheduling, tables, and spreadsheets. Build reusable frontend architecture and components that work consistently across ActAI applications. Integrate streaming AI responses, proactive actions, and model-driven experiences directly into product workflows. Own frontend performance, responsiveness, reliability and accessibility across browsers and devices. Work closely with product and design to take ideas from prototype to production quickly. What We're Looking For Strong experience building complex, production web applications using React, TypeScript and modern frontend technologies. Deep understanding of frontend architecture, state management, browser APIs, and performance. Experience building highly interactive products such as chat, collaboration, productivity, document editing, calendars, or workspaces. Experience with real-time systems, WebSockets, streaming APIs, or collaborative interfaces. Strong product and UI judgment with attention to interaction details. Able to independently own features from technical design through production. Outcomes Users can communicate, write, organise and collaborate seamlessly across Chat, Notes, Calendar, Docs and Sheets. Complex interactions such as group messaging, editing, scheduling and collaboration feel fast and reliable. AI capabilities are integrated naturally into product workflows rather than added as separate chatbot experiences. Frontend architecture remains fast, maintainable and reusable as ActAI expands into new applications and workflows. Tech Stack TypeScript React.js / Next.js HTML / CSS WebSockets / streaming APIs Node.js REST / GraphQL APIs How We Work The best products today in the world were built by small, world-class teams. Joining our team requires the ability to bring structure, exercise judgment and execute independently. Our goal is to put in the hands of our users a truly magical product. Your work spans model and threshold tuning, deep analytical investigation into detection performance, and building the customer-facing narrative that shows exactly what's improved and why. You've done this in front of customers before, and you know the difference between a model that scores well in a notebook and one that survives contact with a real investigator's workload. Key Responsibilities Tune and optimize detection models and thresholds against each customer's live transaction data, balancing detection effectiveness against false positive load, not just against a benchmark dataset. Document your reasoning so a customer's audit or regulator review holds up. Bring rigor to how you validate model changes before they go live: backtesting, sample review, and sign-off discipline that protects the customer's compliance posture. Your Profile 5-7 years as a data scientist in a customer-facing role, presenting analysis and defending model decisions directly to clients. This is not an internal-facing engineering or product data science background; you've sat across the table from a customer before. Real experience in AML, fraud detection, or financial crime analytics is required. You understand transaction monitoring, typologies, and what a false positive actually costs an investigator, not just what one costs on a confusion matrix. Strong hands-on skills in the standard data science stack (Python, SQL, and whatever ML tooling you've used in production), but your edge is judgment under ambiguity: knowing when a model change is safe to make and when it needs a human in the loop. Comfortable being the technical voice in a room with a customer's risk, compliance, or data science stakeholders, and holding your own when questioned. description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>Strength in Trust </h3> <p><span data-contrast="auto">OneTrust’s mission is to enable innovation through the responsible use of data and AI. We believe that ensuring data is trusted shouldn’t slow teams down—it should accelerate what’s possible. This led us to develop the first technology platform for responsible data use in 2016. Today, with AI representing the latest and most impactful expansion of data yet, OneTrust is once again redefining what responsible innovation looks like. OneTrust, the AI‑Ready Governance Platform™, unifies regulatory intelligence, automation, and connected governance workflows so businesses can continue to move at the speed of AI while ensuring good governance to prevent data misuse at scale. title: Senior Growth Director (Commercial Lead)
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>About Moloco:</strong></p> <p>Moloco is an AI-native performance advertising company, bringing the power of AI advertising to the open internet. Founded in 2013 by machine learning engineers who had built AI advertising systems inside the world's largest technology companies, Moloco began from a shared mission: to build that same engine for the open internet.</p> <p>Today, Moloco is one company with two businesses, built on the same compound AI system. <a href="https://www.moloco.com/moloco-ads"><strong>Moloco Ads</strong></a> is our AI-native performance advertising platform, helping mobile app marketers acquire, retain, and re-engage high-value users across the open internet. <a href="https://www.moloco.com/moloco-commerce-media"><strong>Moloco Commerce Media</strong></a> is our AI-native retail media platform, enabling retailers and marketplaces to turn their platforms into thriving ad businesses. Both are powered by<strong> CARA (Compound Ad Recommendation Architecture)</strong>, the AI system behind every Moloco product.</p> <p>At Moloco, we bring together those who've already solved hard problems and those with the drive to. Here, we work on some of the complex problems in AI advertising, at a scale and level of sophistication very few companies can offer. <strong>Come build what's next.</strong></p></div><p><strong>The Impact You’ll Be Contributing to Moloco:</strong></p> <p>Join Moloco as a Senior Growth Director and lead the strategic growth of some of our most important partners across EMEA. As a senior individual contributor, you will own a dedicated portfolio of top accounts, building executive partnerships and developing commercial strategies that create lasting value for customers and Moloco.</p> <p>You will bring a deep understanding of each customer’s business, connect their priorities to Moloco’s capabilities, and lead our most complex commercial conversations. Your impact will extend beyond your own portfolio through selective support on high-stakes opportunities, coaching, and influencing Moloco’s product and commercial direction.</p> <p><strong>The Opportunity:</strong></p> <p>Based in London, you’ll operate as a Commercial Lead within the EMEA Growth team, accountable for substantial revenue outcomes and long-term customer growth. This is an individual contributor role combining hands-on account ownership with commercial leadership across the wider team.</p> <p><span style="text-decoration: underline;">Strategic Growth & Commercial Ownership</span></p> <ul> <li>Own and deliver revenue targets across a dedicated portfolio of top EMEA accounts, with accountability for forecast accuracy, risk management, and long-term growth.</li> <li>Set and drive the multi-year growth agenda for your customers, leading joint business planning with executive stakeholders to secure investment commitments, establish shared accountability, and drive delivery against ambitious commercial goals.</li> <li>Unlock incremental revenue through expansion into new geographies, business units, use cases, and product adoption.</li> <li>Own the most complex and ambiguous commercial negotiations across your portfolio, structuring non-standard agreements in partnership with Sales, Finance, Legal, and leadership to balance customer value, commercial risk, and sustainable growth.</li> </ul> <p><span style="text-decoration: underline;">Consultative Selling & Executive Partnership</span></p> <ul> <li>Act as a trusted commercial advisor and industry expert to your customers, combining deep knowledge of their business models and company goals with insight into market dynamics and competitive trends to challenge assumptions, shape growth strategies, and identify where Moloco can create lasting business value.</li> <li>Develop tailored proposals grounded in customer business outcomes, including lifetime value, payback period, and return on ad spend at scale.</li> <li>Build long-term strategic partnerships with customers, independently owning C-suite and senior commercial relationships and aligning Moloco’s role in their growth with shared objectives, investment priorities, and measures of success.</li> <li>Use trusted executive relationships to shape customer priorities, influence investment decisions, and unlock growth opportunities beyond existing campaigns—including opening doors to new decision-makers, business units, and markets.</li> <li>Lead executive business reviews and strategic planning conversations, translating performance data into clear recommendations for long-term growth.</li> </ul> <p><span style="text-decoration: underline;">Product Expertise & Cross-Functional Influence</span></p> <ul> <li>Apply deep knowledge of Moloco’s products, machine learning capabilities, and the mobile advertising ecosystem to shape credible solutions for customers.</li> <li>Work hands-on with data to test growth hypotheses, diagnose challenges, and build commercially sound recommendations.</li> <li>Act as the voice of the market, partnering with Product, Data Science, and Engineering to translate customer needs, industry trends, and competitive insights into recommendations that shape product priorities and unlock growth.</li> <li>Lead the commercial development of new and ambiguous growth opportunities, setting direction, mobilising cross-functional teams, and driving customer validation to turn successful approaches into repeatable revenue opportunities across EMEA.</li> <li>Influence senior cross-functional stakeholders to prioritise strategic account opportunities, secure resources, and resolve competing priorities to deliver commercial outcomes.</li> </ul> <p><span style="text-decoration: underline;">Coaching & Commercial Leadership</span></p> <ul> <li>Set the standard for consultative selling, deal strategy, negotiation, and executive engagement across EMEA, leading by example in your own accounts and coaching Growth Managers and Growth Directors to strengthen their commercial capabilities.</li> <li>Bring senior commercial expertise to accounts beyond your own portfolio, working alongside account owners to lead high-stakes customer conversations, navigate complex negotiations, and resolve escalations.</li> <li>Turn successful approaches into practical frameworks and playbooks that raise commercial standards across EMEA.</li> <li>Build a reputation as a recognised industry expert in adtech and mobile growth, actively speaking at industry events and sharing insights that strengthen Moloco’s credibility with customers and the wider market.</li> <li>Adapt your leadership and communication style to the audience and situation, using expertise and sound judgment to build trust, navigate disagreement, and secure commitment to action without formal management authority.</li> </ul> <p><strong>How Do I Know if the Role Is Right for Me?</strong></p> <p><span style="text-decoration: underline;">Experience & Expertise</span></p> <ul> <li>10+ years of experience in mobile advertising, account management, consultative sales, or commercial leadership.</li> <li>A proven track record of owning and growing some of an organisation’s largest and most strategically important accounts, navigating complex customer relationships and delivering substantial, sustained revenue growth.</li> <li>Experience leading complex commercial negotiations and structuring agreements around customer business objectives.</li> <li>Demonstrated ability to build trusted executive relationships and influence strategic investment decisions.</li> <li>Deep understanding of the mobile advertising ecosystem, mobile measurement partners (MMPs), attribution, and programmatic performance marketing.</li> <li>Evidence of improving commercial outcomes beyond your own accounts through coaching, co-selling, or cross-functional leadership.</li> <li>Fluency in English (Turkish a strong plus).</li> </ul> <p><span style="text-decoration: underline;">Skills & Mindset</span></p> <ul> <li>Exceptional commercial judgment and the ability to understand how customers make money, assess opportunities, and make disciplined trade-offs.</li> <li>Strong product and analytical fluency, with the ability to connect technical capabilities and performance data to business value.</li> <li>Executive presence and clear written and verbal communication, including the ability to simplify complex issues for senior audiences.</li> <li>High ownership and resilience, with the ability to sustain momentum through long commercial cycles and changing priorities.</li> <li>Comfort operating autonomously in ambiguous situations, creating clarity and mobilizing others around a shared outcome.</li> <li>A collaborative, low-ego approach, with a commitment to learning, sharing credit, and developing others.</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>Supporting Your Best Work and Your Best Life:</strong></p> <p>Our benefits are designed to support our people in doing their best work and living well, at work and beyond. Benefits vary by country, employment type, and eligibility. Connect with a recruiter to learn more about benefits in your region.</p> <p><strong>Moloco Values: </strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Lead with Humility:</strong> Everyone’s voice is respected, valued, and heard. We win, lose, and learn together. Accountability and feedback are essential to our success. </li> <li><strong>Uncapped Growth Mindset:</strong> We see all situations as opportunities to learn, grow, and improve as individuals and as an organization. We seek diverse perspectives, encourage curiosity, and promote experimentation to push the boundaries of what’s possible. </li> <li><strong>Create Real Value: </strong>We pursue the most impactful opportunities with intensity and rigor. We take intelligent risks and make disciplined trade-offs to maintain deep focus. We help our customers win by delivering durable value. </li> <li><strong>Go Further Together: </strong>We’re one team working towards one vision. We collaborate proactively and inclusively, involving the right people at the right time and in the right way. We strive to create a more equitable workplace. We won’t let each other fail. </li> </ul> <p><strong>Additional Resources: </strong></p> <ul> <li><a href="https://www.moloco.com/blogs">Moloco Company Blog</a> </li> <li><a href="https://www.moloco.com/company/leadership">Moloco Leadership</a></li> <li><a href="https://www.moloco.com/newsroom">Moloco Newsroom</a> </li> </ul> <p><strong>AI Use in Interviews</strong></p> <p>Our interview process is designed to get to know the real you. title: Partnerships Manager
description: Who we are: Sardine is the leading agentic risk platform for fighting financial crime. Our integrated solution unifies data across risk teams to help organizations stop fraud in real time, prevent AI-driven attacks, and automate fraud and AML operations. Sardine’s platform is strengthened by one of the fastest-growing fraud consortiums in the market, spanning more than 6 billion profiled devices, 800 million consumers, and 3 million businesses worldwide. Leading companies including FIS, GoDaddy, Intuit, Edward Jones, ZoomInfo, and Checkout.com rely on Sardine to secure and grow trust in their products. Our culture: We hire talented, self-motivated individuals with extreme ownership and high growth orientation. We value performance and not hours worked. We believe you shouldn't have to miss your family dinner, your kid's school play, friends get-together, or doctor's appointments for the sake of adhering to an arbitrary work schedule. We're a remote-first team spread across time zones, so no office to report to - work from wherever helps you do your best work. Just a couple of things to keep in mind: pay is based on where you're located, and you'll need to keep a home base in the country you're hired in. So while we love the "coffee shop today, mountains tomorrow" life, this isn't a passport-optional, work-from-anywhere-on-Earth kind of remote - think flexible within your country, not borderless. Location: Remote - London, UK We are a remote-first company with a globally distributed team. You can find your productive zone and work from there. About the Role: As the Partnerships Manager at Sardine, you’ll report directly to our Head of Partnerships. This is a quota-carrying role that combines growing and activating our signed partners with bringing new partners into the ecosystem. You will own a portfolio of strategic partners and drive revenue through them. Additionally, you will help lead partner recruitment efforts from inception. You’ll work closely with Sardine and partner-side sales teams to drive revenue, and collaborate with our Product, Sales Engineering, and Marketing teams to make sure partners are equipped to succeed. You’ll also help shape our channel strategy and position Sardine as the premier fraud and compliance platform within our partners’ customer bases. This is a high-impact role that will drive meaningful revenue over time and help make partnerships one of the largest channels for Sardine. You’ll work directly with the Head of Partnerships, Sales leadership, and other members of the leadership team, and play a key role in taking Sardine to the next level. What You’ll Be Doing: Drive revenue: Own a partner portfolio and carry a quota across straight reseller, co-sell, and referral relationships, working with partner and Sardine sales teams to close deals Grow across three motions: Partner with Platforms including Payments, Networks, Processors, Banking, AI Ecosystem and other players that embed Sardine, SIs and consultancies that resell, and advisory firms, data partners and VCs who refer prospects Enable partners: Enable partner sales and customer support teams to effectively pitch and demo Sardine through training, material creation, and more. Generate demand: Collaborate with partners to build and execute joint marketing and BDR campaigns directed at their prospects and clients. Recruit and expand: Recruit, onboard, and launch new partners from outreach through first deal, and broaden the scope of signed partners over time Plan and optimize: Set targets, build channel strategies, and report on performance, including product gaps and pricing considerations to optimize distribution Collaborate cross-functionally: Work with Product, Sales Engineering, Marketing, and Sales to ensure Sardine is ready on partner platforms, including embedded deployments What You’ll Need: 8+ years of partnership management or years of related experience in B2B software/SaaS, with a record of consistently exceeding quota Experience managing a mix of partner types such as resellers, SIs, platform partners, and referral partners Executive presence and the ability to build long-term partner relationships Hands-on experience with CRM/Salesforce, reporting, and analytics Strong project management, communication, and strategic thinking, with the ability to collaborate in virtual, matrixed teams Avid user of Agentic AI tools to optimize performance with a lifetime learning mindset Highly preferred: Background in financial services, fintech, AI or fraud and compliance software Highly preferred: Existing network within the financial services or partner ecosystem Benefits we offer: Generous compensation in cash and equity Early exercise for all options, including pre-vested Work from anywhere: Remote-first Culture Flexible paid time off and Year-end break Health insurance, dental, and vision coverage for employees and dependents - US and Canada specific 4% matching in 401k / RRSP - US and Canada specific MacBook Pro delivered to your door One-time stipend to set up a home office — desk, chair, screen, etc. Monthly meal stipend Monthly social meet-up stipend Annual health and wellness stipend Annual Learning stipend Join a fast-growing company with world-class professionals from around the world. If you are seeking a meaningful career, you found the right place, and we would love to hear from you. To learn more about how we process your personal information and your rights in regards to your personal information as an applicant and Sardine employee, please visit our Applicant and Worker Privacy Notice . title: HR Manager
description: About 3E: 3E is a mission-driven company dedicated to creating a safer and more sustainable world. We offer award-winning regulatory intelligence and AI solutions to help organizations protect people and products. With over 35 years of experience and a global presence, we empower our customers with innovative compliance solutions. You will get to work at a company that combines startup agility with the stability of an industry leader. Partner with enterprise customers and global experts to advance environmental safety and solve complex data science challenges. Join us and make an impact! About the Role 3E is growing, and with the recent acquisition of the Yordas Group, we have an exciting opportunity to shape how our UK teams come together and work as part of a broader global organization. We’re looking for an experienced HR Manager who can play a key role in integration today while helping build the strong, scalable HR practices that will support our teams well beyond the transition. As a trusted, hands-on partner to employees and leaders, you’ll help people navigate change while ensuring day-to-day HR operations run effectively. Looking beyond the integration, you’ll work closely with colleagues across our global HR organization to strengthen people practices, improve processes and systems, and contribute to regional and global initiatives as the role evolves. This role requires a regular presence in our Lancaster office, with a minimum of three days onsite each week. Being close to the teams you support will help you build strong relationships, understand the local organization and culture, and provide responsive, effective HR support. If you enjoy building relationships, improving how things work, and helping people navigate change, this is an opportunity to make a meaningful contribution during an important transition and help shape the future of HR operations at 3E. What You’ll Do Serve as a trusted HR advisor to UK employees, managers, and leaders on employee relations, performance management, absence, grievances, disciplinary matters, and workplace investigations. Help employees and managers navigate organizational changes, including integration activities, new HR processes, benefits changes, communications, and culture initiatives. Manage complex employee relations matters with appropriate judgment, documentation, and alignment with UK employment law and company policies. Oversee key HR operations across the employee lifecycle, including onboarding, offboarding, employee changes, leave administration, benefits, and employee records. Serve as a UK subject matter resource for payroll-related legislation and statutory requirements, partnering with Finance, the regional HR team, and external payroll providers. Manage regional HR and benefits vendors, resolving issues and helping ensure employees receive responsive, high-quality support. Maintain and improve HR policies, procedures, employee resources, and documentation in line with employment legislation and business needs. You’ll combine deep expertise in qualitative and quantitative methods to find the unmet needs, behavioral shifts, and market openings that point to new products and new growth. You’ll work as a peer to senior product, design, engineering, data science, and business leaders, and your work will directly inform roadmaps, investment decisions, and company-level strategy.</p> <p>This role is built for a seasoned researcher who is equally comfortable in a living room interview, a survey dataset, and a leadership review, and who uses AI as a daily tool to move faster and see further, without giving up the judgment that makes research trustworthy. You’ll also raise the bar for the wider research practice by mentoring researchers, sharing methods, and helping the team define what great looks like in an AI-enabled era.</p> <h3 data-path-to-node="7">What You’ll Be Doing</h3> <p><strong>Shape Product Strategy: </strong>Translate deep understanding of Consumers, Merchants, and Couriers into a clear point of view on where DoorDash should play and win. You’ll frame the highest-stakes questions, bring evidence to roadmap and investment debates, and influence decisions at the director and executive level.</p> <p><strong>Detect New Opportunities: </strong>Proactively identify emerging needs, behavior changes, and white space that point to new products, new verticals, and new growth levers. You’ll size and validate opportunities with a mix of foundational discovery, market and competitive context, and behavioral data, and turn them into concepts teams can act on.</p> <p><strong>Lead Mixed-Methods Research: </strong>Design and run rigorous research end to end, choosing the right method for the question: ethnography, in-depth interviews, diary studies, and usability testing alongside surveys, conjoint and MaxDiff, segmentation, experiment design, and behavioral and log analysis. You’ll triangulate across sources so the “what,” the “how much,” and the “why” tell one coherent story.</p> <p><strong>Partner with Data Science and Experimentation: </strong>Work closely with data science and analytics to connect qualitative insight to A/B test design, metrics, and product outcomes, and to explain the “why” behind results. You’ll help teams learn from what worked, what didn’t, and what to test next.</p> <p><strong>Apply AI to the Research Craft: </strong>Use AI tools and LLMs in your daily workflow for synthesis, analysis, survey and discussion guide design, and scaling qualitative depth, and design human-in-the-loop checks that catch confident but wrong outputs. You’ll help the team identify where AI accelerates research and where it should not be trusted, and contribute to shared prompts, workflows, and standards. You’ll also study how people experience AI-powered features across DoorDash’s products.</p> <p><strong>Influence and Communicate: </strong>Tell compelling, decision-ready stories that move partners from insight to action. Working knowledge of SQL, R, or Python for pulling and analyzing your own data is a plus</li> <li>Hands-on experience using AI and LLMs in research (for example, synthesis, analysis, prototyping, or scaling qualitative work), with sound instincts about where they help and where they mislead. Experience researching AI-powered products is a plus</li> <li>Experience in consumer, two-sided or multi-sided marketplace, logistics, commerce, or local services contexts is a plus</li> <li>Exceptional storytelling and executive presence, with the ability to influence senior stakeholders without authority and build trust across product, design, engineering, data science, and business teams</li> <li>A bias for speed and pragmatism: comfortable delivering directional insight quickly while knowing when a decision calls for deeper rigor</li> <li>Experience mentoring or coaching researchers and raising the quality of a research practice</li> <li>Advanced degree in HCI, Psychology, Sociology, Anthropology, Economics, Statistics, Survey Methodology, or a related field preferred, or equivalent practical experience</li> </ul> <h3>Why Join Us?</h3> <p>At Deliveroo, you’ll do work that matters, solving real-world problems in a three-sided marketplace that’s constantly evolving.</p> <p>We’re food lovers, problem solvers, community builders and more, brought together by a shared drive to make things better. Working here you can expect to:</p> <p>🔧 <strong>Solve meaningful problems at real scale</strong> Work on a complex, always-on marketplace that impacts millions every day.</p> <p>🌱 <strong>See your impact, fast</strong> Ship, test and improve ideas quickly in a low-hierarchy, high-ownership environment.</p> <p>🧠 <strong>Grow through challenge and ownership</strong> Take on big, ambiguous problems and accelerate your career with strong support.</p> <p>🌎 <strong>A culture built for builders</strong> High standards, collaboration, flexible working and continuous learning.</p> <p>​​💰 <strong>Share in the success you help create</strong> Competitive salary and equity options, so you’re rewarded for the impact you make.</p> <p>➡️ Want a deeper look at how we build? privacy requirements into scalable, self-service capabilities.</p> <h2><strong>What you'll be doing</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Lead and mentor a high-performing team of backend and platform engineers, title: Senior Software Engineer
description: Our Mission: Scope automates the data collection that's slowing down the physical world. Standards are vital for the safety of our infrastructure. Spending hours manually documenting them is not. Dave is an inspector. Today he’s climbing through one of Europe’s biggest chemical plants, looking for the corrosion that could shut the whole site down, with a notebook and pen in hand. Tomorrow, he’ll spend even longer on the part of the job he hates: turning those scribbles into a report. We’re building the AI-native data collection layer for the 2 billion field workers like Dave. Scope radically simplifies how inspectors collect data in the field, make decisions, and produce reports. Along the way, we’re building the largest dataset on the condition of the built world and the decisions experts make about it. It’s a $2T market and we’re just getting started. We're growing rapidly, and already work with 7 of the top 10 companies in the space. Our customers inspect facilities and products for companies including AstraZeneca and SpaceX. We take pride in our talent density, and have assembled a best-in-class team: acquired and future founders, people from institutions like Imperial, Carnegie Mellon and Oxford, and from firms like Palantir, Goldman Sachs and Flexport . Since launching from Entrepreneurs First in 2024, we've raised an oversubscribed $20m round led by Index Ventures , the firm behind Figma, Revolut and Wiz, with over 100 unicorns backed to date. About the role Real product ownership. You’ll go on site with inspectors, decide what matters, design it, ship it, and see whether it worked. The hard, interesting problems in AI. Field data is messy: voice notes, photos, video, half-finished sentences recorded in a chemical plant with no signal. Turning that into a report an expert will sign is a context-engineering problem nobody has solved well yet. A small team that ships fast . We ship to production every day and put changes in front of inspectors within days, not quarters. Ideas go from a site visit to a live feature in a single sprint. If something doesn’t land, we learn why and iterate quickly. There are no layers of sign-off between you and the user. What you’ll do Redesign the mobile app for how inspectors actually work: gloves on, no signal, one hand holding on Build the systems that takes voice notes, photos, videos and proactively finishes reports without being annoying Engineer how we feed context to AI models : how to store, fetch and select standards, reports, media, user intention Evolve our workflow builder : something between Retool, Webflow and n8n for inspections Design the architecture behind the product : how unstructured data flows through the system, how AI is integrated, how offline and online behaviour stay seamless, and how we keep the product simple as it becomes more powerful. Who you are You’re deeply technical. You’re a little bit sad that AI tooling creates more distance between you and the code, and you still like knowing how things work underneath. You’re a manager of one. We believe great teams are made up of highly agentic people who care more about shipping results than collecting badges. You’ve got the scar tissue. You have 5+ years of experience and know which technical decisions matter, and which ones don’t. You’ve shipped real applications. Ideally mobile, ideally with Expo or React Native. You care about the details that break in the real world: offline, flaky networks, error states. You’re curious about AI as an engineering problem. You’re interested in getting messy real-world inputs into a model and getting something reliable back out, not just in calling an API. Interview process An initial call with our talent team. A collaborative technical exercise with an engineer, usually in Typescript or Python. An Interview with a cofounder - Jonny (CEO) or Jakob (CTO). Onsite Product Interview - Meeting more people on the team and getting a feel of what it would be like to work here. Offer! Compensation and benefits We’re in the office five days a week, so we’ve made it a great place to be. £120k–£150k base + significant equity, so you have a real stake in what you’re building 33 days’ holiday (including bank holidays, which you can take at your discretion.) Bupa private medical: £0 excess, pre-existing conditions covered, digital GP, plus Bupa dental Fresh meal prep delivered every week, a stocked fridge, and team lunch out every Friday Working late? Dinner’s on us, and so is your Uber home Full visa sponsorship New MacBook and whatever tools you need Flexible parental leave, including adoption leave Regular team events and off-sites Compensation: £120K – £150K • Offers Equity • £120K – £150K • Offers Equity Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Customer Operations Specialist - Europe
description: About Plasma Plasma is building the primary account for global money. Money used to belong to a country. Increasingly, it belongs to a person or business moving through many countries. People and businesses now earn, spend, save, hire and invest across borders. Traditional banks cannot serve this new world. Our first product, Plasma One, is a global money account: a place to receive, hold, send funds in seconds, earn yield and spend with a card in the local economy. Underneath is the Plasma network, built from first principles for stablecoin payments. Stablecoins make dollars faster, cheaper and more reliable to move. The opportunity is to become where all global money lands first: where income arrives, balances grow, payments move, businesses operate, and new financial products are built. The Team & Our Story We are a global team of founders, operators and engineers, obsessed with building the best products. We work at the cutting edge of financial innovation, using stablecoins to create tools for consumers and businesses. We operate with trust, clarity, and ambition: own your craft, move with urgency, contribute beyond your lane, back your teammates, debate rigorously, and keep raising the bar for what great means. Customer Experience Plasma is scaling its customer-facing operations across international markets, and we’re growing the Customer Experience Team to match. You’ll join an established team and take ownership of coverage for the CET time zone, making sure our customers get great support when they need it most. You’ll work across the full customer journey, from first contact through to resolution. Because we’re still building out our playbook, your input will directly shape the processes, standards, and team culture as we grow. You won’t just follow the process; you’ll help refine it. Some flexibility in working hours & weekend shifts will be needed to support coverage and the occasional busy period. We’re looking for a hard-working self-starter who thrives in a fast-moving startup environment and is committed to the mission alongside the rest of the team. The role Own the customer experience day-to-day: Be the first person our customers reach when something goes wrong or they need help. You will handle inbound queries across chat, email, and support tooling, and take accountability for the quality and speed of every response. Be the right hand of the Ops lead: Work directly alongside the Head of Operations to build out processes, identify gaps, and support decisions as we scale the team internationally. This is not a back-office support role. You will be involved in how we think about operations. Build the foundations: We are early. Many of the processes, templates, and escalation paths do not exist yet. You will create them. From response frameworks to internal guides, you will help lay the groundwork the team will rely on as we grow. Support international team scaling: As we hire Ops team members in new markets, you will help onboard them, share knowledge, and maintain consistency in how we deliver for customers across regions. Spot problems before they become patterns: Track issues across the customer base, flag recurring themes to Product and Engineering, and help prioritise fixes that actually move the needle for customers. Work across teams: Collaborate with Compliance, KYC, and Product to make sure the customer experience is joined up, especially during onboarding and verification flows where things can go wrong quickly. Represent the customer internally: Your proximity to customer feedback is valuable. Use it. Bring customer insight into internal conversations and push for improvements that matter. Be Flexible with Shift Rotation: Most weeks you’ll work the normal Mon-Fri, however team members currently rotate weekend shifts which means that you may be required to work a weekend shift once every 6 weeks. You’ll then be able to take those days worked off the following week. The Bar 1 to 3 years of experience in customer operations, customer success, or a support role, ideally within fintech, payments, or crypto. We will consider strong candidates from outside these sectors if the fit is right. Someone who takes ownership. You do not wait to be told. When something is broken or missing, you fix it or flag it. You hold yourself to a high standard even when no one is watching. Clear and direct in how you communicate. You can write a helpful, professional response under pressure and explain a complex situation simply. You know the difference between being thorough and overcomplicating things. Competent English Language - our team communicates in english so being competent with the language is a requirement. Comfortable with ambiguity. This is an early-stage company. Processes will change, priorities will shift, and some days you will be figuring things out as you go. You see that as interesting rather than frustrating. Preferably, you have worked at a fast-paced tech company. Genuinely curious about crypto. You do not need deep technical knowledge, but you need to understand the basics of how stablecoins and digital assets work and be motivated to learn more. Our customers live in this space. Organised under pressure. You can manage a queue, prioritise effectively, and keep quality high when things are busy. Collaborative by default. You work well with people in different functions, different time zones, and different levels of seniority. Building the team abroad means working with people you may never meet in person, and you are good at that. Nice to have Experience in a startup or scale-up where you had to build or rebuild processes, not just follow them. Exposure to Intercom, Zendesk, Freshdesk , or similar support tooling in a live production environment. Any familiarity with KYC or compliance workflows as they relate to customer onboarding. Experience supporting or managing a small team , even informally, or helping onboard new colleagues. An interest in how stablecoin and DeFi products work and the customer challenges they create. Multilingual skills that could support customer communication across our international markets. What's in it for you Above-market salary for the level of the role, with token compensation. A beautiful London HQ with gym access and daily food, for those who thrive in an office environment. Visa sponsorship and relocation support if you're joining from abroad. Premium health insurance for you and your family, fully covered by Plasma. Monthly wellness budget, whether that's the gym, therapy, sauna, or massage. All the tools and tech you need to operate at your best. Real ownership and responsibility from day one, with your work shipping to hundreds of thousands of people, moving millions of dollars every day. Any personal information you provide during the recruitment process will be processed in accordance with the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) and applicable local data protection laws. title: Director of Engineering - Risk and Compliance
description: Company Description We’re Checkout.com . You might not know our name, but companies like eBay, Spotify, Klarna, Uber, and Sony do, because we’re behind many of the digital experiences you use every day. We are where the world checks out, enabling over 10 billion transactions yearly for more than one billion global shoppers. Whether you want to book a holiday, order food, renew a subscription, or check out online, there’s a good chance our tech powers the payments behind the scenes. Our platform helps the most ambitious businesses deliver effortless digital experiences, at scale. If you want to do career-defining work, you’ve come to the right place. We move fast, think globally, and believe great teams are built by hiring exceptional people with conviction, curiosity, and the desire to make an impact. With 20 offices across six continents and London as our HQ, we’re shaping the future of fintech – and we’re just getting started. Role overview | Context Checkout.com built its name serving the world's largest enterprises. We're now growing into many more types of customer: businesses of every size, including self-serve, startups integrating straight from our docs, and platforms (software companies, payfacs and marketplaces) that onboard thousands of sellers through our APIs. As our product range grows, that takes us from thousands of customers to millions. At that scale, the decision about who we work with, and on what terms, can't be a manual review at the end of a sales process. It has to be a product. It decides how quickly a good business goes live, how much it costs us to serve them, and how confident our regulators and scheme partners are in us. We're looking for a senior Engineering leader to own that decision. This team decides which businesses we can work with and on what terms. It covers business verification, screening, underwriting, ongoing monitoring and financial crime. It's a shared platform that serves every one of our businesses. Its users are our customers (directly, or through the platforms they sign up with) and, internally, our Risk, Compliance and Financial Crime teams and the analysts who run reviews and investigations. Much of what we have today was built segment by segment and market by market, for a smaller number of large customers. The next chapter is one opinionated, configurable decisioning platform. Enterprise, platform and SMB customers should all run on the same foundations, with the right depth of checks and the right terms for each. That way a new product, segment or market doesn't mean rebuilding our controls, and this team isn't on the critical path for every launch. Role overview | Risk, Verification & Compliance The remit covers: Risk decisioning: underwriting, risk tiering, exposure limits, reserves and settlement terms, and when to restrict or offboard, re-assessed across the customer lifecycle. Business verification: company, ownership, document, bank account and website checks, run once for every segment. Financial crime: sanctions and PEP screening, AML and transaction monitoring, and the controls, audit trails and reporting behind our regulatory obligations. Decisioning platform: the shared infrastructure that runs these checks automatically for every market and customer type. You'll partner closely with the teams that own onboarding and identity verification. Role overview | Remit and Responsibilities You'll be comfortable building and scaling critical platforms in a regulated environment, where correctness, auditability and availability matter as much as speed. You'll balance two goals that are often in tension: making it fast and easy for good businesses to work with us, and keeping bad actors out and the business compliant. This is a change role. You'll assess what we have, set a clear direction, and move us from segment-specific, analyst-led processes to an automated decisioning platform, without pausing the business while you do it. You'll do this in close partnership with Product, Risk, Compliance, Financial Crime and Legal, and with the leaders of the businesses that depend on the platform. You'll directly lead an established team of engineers and managers of varying seniorities. Amongst other duties, you'll have impact across: Setting the technical vision and strategy for Risk, Verification & Compliance. That includes deciding what we build once and share, and what each segment, product or market configures. Building a decisioning platform that automates the decisions that don't need a human, safely, and sends the rest to the right analyst with the context they need. Our automation rate sets our cost to onboard and to serve. Making risk dynamic across the customer lifecycle. New businesses start on terms that match the signals we see: limits, reserves and settlement speed. Those terms relax automatically as the business trades well, and we act quickly when the signals change. This starts with simple rules and evolves into machine learning. Making decisions explainable, so that customers, partners and our own analysts understand why a decision was made and what happens next. Giving Risk and Compliance the dials. Acceptance criteria, early-life controls and policy should be configuration that can be changed, tested and measured by cohort, not a code change. Keeping our financial crime controls ahead of growth. Screening and monitoring have to scale from large enterprises to a very large base of smaller businesses, through new channels, payment methods and products. Leading the design and delivery of verification, screening, underwriting and monitoring systems that are accurate, auditable and highly available. Representing Engineering in regulatory, audit, scheme and partner conversations where needed. Managing and developing a high-performing team of individual contributor (IC) Engineers and Engineering Managers, providing guidance, support and career development. Striving for best practice on hiring, coaching and enablement, and being a magnet for top talent. Role overview | Desired Background, Core Competencies The ideal candidate for the role will bring: Experience leading multi-level engineering organisations (EMs and ICs) through growth and change, with a track record of developing leaders, not just hiring them. A record of transforming critical platforms while the business kept running: multi-year re-architecture, migrations, or consolidating several systems into one. Experience building and operating mission-critical decisioning or rules platforms at scale. Ideally these served several customer segments, products or markets from a shared foundation. Experience in a regulated environment (financial services, payments or similar), where compliance, auditability and risk are part of the engineering problem. Deep technical understanding of cloud-native, distributed and data-heavy systems, including how to run ML models safely in production. Exceptional collaboration skills, with a proven ability to partner with senior cross-functional stakeholders, particularly in Risk, Compliance, Financial Crime and Legal, and to make clear trade-offs in a complex stakeholder landscape. Ideally, domain knowledge in KYB, AML and financial crime, underwriting, fraud or merchant risk. Experience with self-serve or high-volume onboarding, or with platforms and their sub-merchants, is a strong plus. Humility, low ego and an ideal ambassador for our mission, values and operating principles. If you feel that you don't meet all the requirements but think you might still be right for the role, please consider continuing in the process. We're always keen to build relationships with leaders who resonate with our mission and values. Additional Information Bring all of you to work We create the conditions for high performers to thrive, through real ownership, fewer blockers, and work that makes a difference from day one. Here, you’ll move fast, take on meaningful challenges, and be recognized for the impact you deliver. It’s a place where ambition gets met with opportunity, and where your growth is in your hands. We work as one team, and we back each other to succeed. So whatever your background or identity, if you’re ready to grow and make a difference, you’ll be right at home here. It’s important we set you up for success and make our process as accessible as possible. So let us know in your application, or tell your recruiter directly, if you need anything to make your experience or working environment more comfortable. Our hybrid working model offers flexibility, with three days per week in the office to support collaboration and connection. Curious about what it’s like to be part of our team? title: Principal (European Competition practice)
description: <h4>About Charles River Associates</h4> <p>Charles River Associates is a leading global consulting firm that provides economic, financial, and business management expertise to major law firms, corporations and governments around the world. CRA advises clients on economic and financial matters pertaining to litigation and regulatory proceedings, and guides corporations through critical business strategy and performance-related issues. Since 1965, clients have engaged CRA for its combination of industry experience and rigorous, fact-based analysis that provide clients with clear, implementable solutions to complex business concerns.</p> <p>CRA's European Competition Practice specialises in providing economic advice on matters of competition policy and regulation. We assist firms and their legal advisors in all types of competition proceedings: firms considering merger and acquisition opportunities or involved in merger control proceedings; and firms undergoing investigations relating to cartels, restrictive commercial agreements, abuse of dominance or state aid. We also provide advice to firms involved in regulatory proceedings and sector inquiries. We offer assistance on the estimation of effects and damages in cartel cases, international arbitration and intellectual property disputes.</p> <p><em><strong>For more information on the Antitrust and Competition Economics practice in Europe visit</strong> <strong><span style="text-decoration: underline;">http://ecp.crai.com</span></strong>.</em></p> <h4>Position Overview</h4> <p>Principals have the unique opportunity to learn from, and work alongside, some of the most respected scholars, specialists, and industry experts in the world.  We tailor our analyses to the facts of each case, employing tools such as merger simulation, upward pricing pressure analysis, econometrics, bargaining theory, or game theory as needed. Whether before a court or a regulatory agency, CRA consultants set a high standard for the clear communication of sophisticated economic analysis in complex cases. You will have access to internal training programs focused on creative problem solving, communications, and leading and managing colleagues, teams and cases.  In addition, our firm offers proceedings to provide economic analyses of mergers and other competition matters before the major competition authorities of the world;</li> <li>Assist with recruiting and training of new junior colleagues;</li> <li>Executive client presence and interaction skills. </li> </ul> <h4>To Apply</h4> <section class="top"> <div class="container-fluid"> <div class="col-md-9 stack"> <div description: <div class="content-intro"><h2 class="job-details__description-header text-color-secondary font-family-secondary" data-bind="i18n: 'job-details.employer-description-title'">About Us</h2> <div class="job-details__description-content basic-formatter" data-bind="html: pageData().job.corporateDescription"> <div>Fanatics is building a leading global digital sports platform. We ignite the passions of global sports fans and maximize the presence and reach for our hundreds of sports partners globally by offering products and services across Fanatics Commerce, Fanatics Collectibles, and Fanatics Betting & Gaming, allowing sports fans to Buy, Collect, and Bet. Through the Fanatics platform, sports fans can buy licensed fan gear, jerseys, lifestyle and streetwear products, headwear, and hardgoods; collect physical and digital trading cards, sports memorabilia, and other digital assets; and bet as the company builds its Sportsbook and iGaming platform. Fanatics has an established database of over 100 million global sports fans; a global partner network with approximately 900 sports properties, including major national and international professional sports leagues, players associations, teams, colleges, college conferences and retail partners, 2,500 athletes and celebrities, and 200 exclusive athletes; and over 2,000 retail locations, including its Lids retail stores. Our more than 22,000 employees are committed to relentlessly enhancing the fan experience and delighting sports fans globally. </div> </div> <p> </p></div><p><strong>About the Team</strong></p> <p>Fanatics Collectibles is the home of sports cards, trading cards, and collectibles for over 100 million fans worldwide. As part of the global Fanatics platform, we're rebuilding how collectors discover, buy, sell, and experience their hobby — live, in real time, at scale.</p> <p>Our flagship mobile product, <strong>Fanatics Live</strong>, is where that experience comes to life: live card breaks, real-time auctions, high-traffic chat, marketplace transactions, and deep collection management tools. The stakes are high and the traffic is real — we build for peak-load moments where latency is visible and reliability is nonnegotiable.</p> <p><strong>Role Summary</strong></p> <p>You'll join the <strong>Instant Rips</strong> iOS team — the group responsible for the live-break commerce experience on Fanatics Live. We build the surfaces millions of collectors use in real time: bidding in live auctions, joining breaks, navigating a high-velocity chat stream, and transacting in the marketplace.</p> <p>The iOS stack is modern by design. We're SwiftUI-first, run The Composable Architecture TCA) across the app, use Swift Concurrency throughout, talk to our backend via Apollo GraphQL, and maintain a clean modular SPM codebase generated with Tuist. There's no legacy UIKit app hiding under the surface — you'll be working in a codebase you can be proud of.</p> <p>AI tooling is part of how we work. We expect engineers to use it on the job, give it good context, and verify the output — not just accept it.</p> <h4>What you'll do</h4> <ul> <li>Design and ship production iOS features across the live-break experience: auctions, stream viewing, chat, marketplace, and collector tools</li> <li>Own features end-to-end — API contracts, TCA reducers, SwiftUI views, testing, and release</li> <li>Write genuine test coverage: unit tests with mock dependencies, TCA</li> <li>TestStore assertions, async test patterns — not coverage theater</li> <li>Review pull requests with judgment: surface real defects, prioritize what matters, coach on what to let go</li> <li>Contribute to architectural decisions: modularization strategy, effect management, failure handling</li> <li>Mentor engineers earlier in their career and raise the quality bar across the team</li> </ul> <h4>What we're looking for</h4> <ul> <li><strong>5+ years</strong> building consumer-facing iOS applications at scale</li> <li>Hands-on with AI-assisted development tooling LLM optimization loops, Xcode CLI integration)</li> <li><strong>Swift Concurrency</strong> — async/await, structured concurrency, Sendable, Swift Macros</li> <li><strong>SwiftUI</strong> — stateless/stateful view patterns, NavigationStack, performanceaware composition</li> <li><strong>The Composable Architecture TCA</strong> — Reducer/Store/Action/State, effect management, parent-child delegation, testing with TestStore</li> <li><strong>Apollo GraphQL (iOS)</strong> — schema-driven development, Swift codegen, subscriptions</li> <li><strong>SPM multi-package architecture</strong> — modular feature separation, local packages, clean dependency graphs</li> <li><strong>Tuist or XcodeGen</strong> — project generation tooling; no committed <sub>.xcodeproj </sub><strong>CI/CD</strong> — Bitrise, Fastlane, or equivalent automated build/test pipelines <strong>Static analysis</strong> — SwiftLint, Periphery or equivalent code quality gates</li> <li><strong>Structured commit/PR discipline</strong> tied to a project tracker Linear, Jira, or equivalent)</li> </ul> <h4>Bonus points</h4> <ul> <li>Experience with livestreaming, real-time auctions, or high-throughput WebSocket/subscription workloads</li> <li>Exposure to marketplace or e-commerce iOS applications</li> <li>Passion for sports cards, collectibles, or live commerce</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><em>The above list of job duties is not exclusive or exhaustive and the post holder will be required to undertake such tasks as may reasonably be expected within the scope and grading of the post.</em><br><br><em>Subject to applicable laws, Fanatics Collectibles may choose to run a background check.</em></p> <p> </p> <p><em>Ensure your Fanatics job offer is legitimate and don’t fall victim to fraud.  Fanatics never seeks payment from job applicants. Feel free to ask your recruiter for a phone call or other type of communication for interview, and ensure your communication is coming from a Fanatics email address (including ----- For added security, where possible, apply through our company website at <a href="http://www.fanaticsinc.com/careers">www.fanaticsinc.com/careers</a></em></p><div class="content-conclusion"> <p>By submitting your application, you agree to our terms of service and acknowledge you have read our <a href="https://static1.squarespace.com/static/5ff494b9931735466ce28d5b/t/69de53bde2c02c25e9c38758/1776178110037/Candidate+Privacy+Policy+April+2026.pdf" target="_blank">Candidate Privacy Policy.</a></p> <p><em>Fanatics will never ask candidates for money, banking information, or other sensitive personal information as part of the interview process.
